acalarājakanyakākadarthanayāntarikṣākhyena śaṅkaraśarīreṇa saṃsṛṣṭāyāḥ saṃdhyāṅganāyāḥ raktacandanacarcitaikastanakalaśadarśanīye dinādhināthe janādhināthaḥ sa āgatya janasyāsya dharaṇinyastacaraṇanakhakiraṇacchāditakirīṭaḥ kṛtāñjaliratiṣṭhat
tataḥ kānanabhūmiṣu bhavantamanveṣṭumudyuktaṃ māṃ paramamitraṃ bandhupālo niśamyāvadat sakalaṃ dharaṇitalamapāramanveṣṭumakṣamo bhavānmanoglāniṃ vihāya tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhatu

atha tadākarṇya karṇaśekharanilīnanīlanīrajāyitāṃ dhīratalatārakāṃ dṛśaṃ tiryak kiṃcid añcitāṃ saṃcārayantī salilacaraketanaśarāsanānatāṃ cillikālatāṃ lalāṭaraṅgasthalīnartakīṃ līlālasaṃ lālayantī kaṇṭakitaraktagaṇḍalekhā rāgalajjāntarālacāriṇī caraṇāgreṇa tiraścīnanakhārciścandrikeṇa dharaṇitalaṃ sācīkṛtānanasarasijaṃ likhantī dantacchadakisalayalaṅghinā harṣāsrasaliladhārāśīkarakaṇajālakleditasya stanataṭacandanasyārdratāṃ nirasyatāsyāntarālaniḥsṛtena tanīyasānilena hṛdayalakṣyadalanadakṣiṇaratisahacaraśarasyādāyitena taraṅgitadaśanacandrikāṇi kānicidetānyakṣarāṇi kalakaṇṭhīkalānyasṛjat ārya kena kāraṇenainaṃ dāsajanaṃ kālahastādācchidyānantaraṃ rāgānilacālitaraṇaraṇikātaraṅgiṇy anaṅgasāgare kirasi

so 'ham aho ramaṇīyo 'yaṃ parvatanitambabhāgaḥ kāntatareyaṃ gandhapāṣāṇavatyupatyakā śiśiram idam indīvarāravindamakarandabinducandrakottaraṃ gotravāri ramyo 'yamanekavarṇakusumamañjarībharas taruvanābhogaḥ ityatṛptatarayā dṛśā bahubahu paśyann alakṣitādhyārūḍhakṣoṇīdharaśikharaḥ śoṇībhūtamutprabhābhiḥ padmarāgasopānaśilābhiḥ kimapi nālīkaparāgadhūsaraṃ saraḥ samadhyagamam
tasyāstu jananyudañjaliḥ palitaśāraśikhaṇḍabandhaspṛṣṭamuktabhūmir abhāṣata bhagavan asyā me doṣameṣā vo dāsī vijñāpayati

tannandinīṃ nayanānandakāriṇīṃ suvṛttāṃ nāmaitasmād dvīpādāgato magadhanāthamantrisaṃbhavo ratnodbhavo nāma ramaṇīyaguṇālayo bhrāntabhūvalayo manohārī vyavahāryupayamya suvastusaṃpadā śvaśureṇa saṃmānito 'bhūt
āpadā tu madāpahāriṇyā sadya eva bodhitastatkṣaṇopajātayā pratibhayā vyacīcaram aho mameyaṃ mohamūlā mahatyāpadāpatitā
na caiṣā proṣitabhartṛkā pravāsacihnasya veṇyāderadarśanāt

atha rājñaḥ śrāvastīśvarasya yathārthanāmno dharmavardhanasya kanyāṃ navamālikāṃ gharmakālasubhage kanyāpuravimānaharmyatale viśālakomalatalaṃ śayyātalamadhiśayānāṃ yadṛcchayopalabhya diṣṭyeyaṃ suptā parijanaśca gāḍhanidraḥ

atha mīnaketanasenānāyakena malayagirimahīruhanirantarāvāsibhujaṃgamabhuktāvaśiṣṭeneva sūkṣmatareṇa dhṛtaharicandanaparimalabhareṇeva mandagatinā dakṣiṇānilena viyogihṛdayasthaṃ manmathānalam ujjvalayan sahakārakisalayamakarandāsvādanaraktakaṇṭhānāṃ madhukarakalakaṇṭhānāṃ kākalīkalakalena dikcakraṃ vācālayan māninīmānasotkalikāmupanayan mākandasinduvāraraktāśokakiṃśukatilakeṣu kalikām upapādayan madanamahotsavāya rasikamanāṃsi samullāsayan vasantasamayaḥ samājagāma

tataḥ kadācin nānāvidhamahadāyudhanaipuṇyaracitāgaṇyajanyarājanyamaulipālinihitaniśitasāyako magadhanāyako mālaveśvaraṃ pratyagrasaṅgrāmaghasmaraṃ samutkaṭamānasāraṃ mānasāraṃ prati sahelaṃ nyakkṛtajaladhinirghoṣāhaṅkāreṇa bherījhaṅkāreṇa haṭhikākarṇanākrāntabhayacaṇḍimānaṃ digdantāvalavalayaṃ vighūrṇannijabharanamanmedinībhareṇākrāntabhujagarājamastakabalena caturaṅgabalena saṃyutaḥ saṅgrāmābhilāṣeṇa roṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭo niryayau
māṃ tu na kaścid ihatya īdṛktayā jano jānāti
tadasya sakalakleśasahasya rājavāhanasya digvijayaprayāṇaṃ kriyatām iti

athāham āvirbhūya vivṛtadīpabhājanaḥ bhāmini nanu bahvaparāddhaṃ bhavatyā cittajanmano yadamuṣya jīvitabhūtā ratirākṛtyā kadarthitā dhanuryaṣṭirbhrūlatābhyām bhramaramālāmayī jyā nīlālakadyutibhiḥ astrāṇyapāṅgavīkṣitavṛṣṭibhiḥ mahārajanarañjitadhvajapaṭāṃśukaṃ dantacchadamayūkhajālaiḥ prathamasuhṛnmalayamārutaḥ parimalapaṭīyasā niḥśvāsapavanena parabhṛto 'timañjulaiḥ pralāpaiḥ puṣpamayī patākā bhujayaṣṭibhyām digvijayārambhapūrṇakumbhamithunam urojakumbhayugalena krījāsaro nābimamḍalena saṃnāhyarathaḥ śroṇimaṇḍalena bhavanaratnatoraṇastambhayugalam ūruyugalena līlākarṇakisalayaṃ caraṇatalaprabhābhiḥ
sahacarasametasya nūnametasya digvijayārambhasamayaḥ eṣaḥ
gamyajanaśca bhūyānarthayogyaḥ pratyācakṣāṇayānayā prakopitaḥ

tayoratha rathaturagakhurakṣuṇṇakṣoṇīsamudbhūte karighaṭākaṭasravanmadadhārādhautamūle navyavallabhavaraṇāgatadivyakanyājanajavanikāpaṭamaṇḍapa iva viyattalavyākule dhūlīpaṭale diviṣaddhvani dhikkṛtānyadhvanipaṭahadhvānabadhiritāśeṣadigantarālaṃ śastrāśastri hastāhasti parasparābhihatasainyaṃ janyam ajani
tacchrutvā lubdhena tu daṇḍavāhinā pauravṛddhasaṃnidhau nidhipatidattasya kanyāṃ kanakavatīṃ moṣeṇāpahṛtyāsmatpure nivasatyeṣa durmatirbalabhadraḥ
tairbahudhā vijñāpito 'pyakharveṇa garveṇa virājamāno rājā tad vākyam akṛtyam ity anādṛtya pratiyoddhumanā babhūva
so 'bravīt asti baddho matpituḥ kanīyānbhrātā prahāravarmā

athāham āvirbhūya vivṛtadīpabhājanaḥ bhāmini nanu bahvaparāddhaṃ bhavatyā cittajanmano yadamuṣya jīvitabhūtā ratirākṛtyā kadarthitā dhanuryaṣṭirbhrūlatābhyām bhramaramālāmayī jyā nīlālakadyutibhiḥ astrāṇyapāṅgavīkṣitavṛṣṭibhiḥ mahārajanarañjitadhvajapaṭāṃśukaṃ dantacchadamayūkhajālaiḥ prathamasuhṛnmalayamārutaḥ parimalapaṭīyasā niḥśvāsapavanena parabhṛto 'timañjulaiḥ pralāpaiḥ puṣpamayī patākā bhujayaṣṭibhyām digvijayārambhapūrṇakumbhamithunam urojakumbhayugalena krījāsaro nābimamḍalena saṃnāhyarathaḥ śroṇimaṇḍalena bhavanaratnatoraṇastambhayugalam ūruyugalena līlākarṇakisalayaṃ caraṇatalaprabhābhiḥ
anyadā bandhupālaḥ śakunairbhavadgatiṃ prekṣiṣyamāṇaḥ puropāntavihāravanaṃ mayā sahopetya kasmiṃścinmahīruhe śakuntavacanāni śṛṇvannatiṣṭhat

tato devasyānveṣaṇaparāyaṇo 'hamakhilakāryanimittaṃ vittaṃ niścitya bhavadanugrahāllabdhasya sādhakasya sāhāyyakaraṇadakṣaṃ śiṣyagaṇaṃ niṣpādya vindhyavanamadhye purātanapattanasthānānyupetya vividhasūcakānāṃ mahīruhāṇāmadhonikṣiptān vasupūrṇān kalaśān siddhāñjanena jñātvā rakṣiṣu paritaḥ sthiteṣu khananasādhanairutpāṭya dīnārānasaṃkhyān rāśīkṛtya tatkālāgatamanatidūre niveśitaṃ vaṇikkaṭakaṃ kaṃcid abhyetya tatra balino balīvardān goṇīśca krītvānyadravyamiṣeṇa vasu tadgoṇīsaṃcitaṃ tairuhyamānaṃ śanaiḥ kaṭakamanayam
vipro 'sau bahutanayo vidvānnirdhanaḥ sthaviraśca dānayogya iti tasmai karuṇāpūrṇamanā ratnamadām

anurañjitātape tu samaye janasamājajñānopayogīni saṃhṛtya nṛtyagītanānāruditāni hastacaṅkramaṇam ūrdhvapādālātapādapīṭhavṛścikamakaralaṅghanādīni matsyodvartanādīni ca karaṇāni punar ādāyādāyāsannavartināṃ kṣurikāḥ tābhirupāhitavarṣmā citraduṣkarāṇi karaṇāni śyenapātotkrośapātādīni darśayan viṃśaticāpāntarālāvasthitasya pracaṇḍavarmaṇaśchurikayaikayā pratyurasaṃ prahṛtya jīvyād varṣasahasraṃ vasantabhānuḥ ityabhigarjan madgātram arūkartum udyatāseḥ kasyāpi cārabhaṭasya pīvarāṃsabāhuśikharamākramya tāvataiva taṃ vicetākurvan sākulaṃ ca lokam uccakṣūkurvan dvipuruṣocchritaṃ prākāram atyalaṅghayam
tato 'grajanmā narasiṃhasya hiraṇyakaśipordaityeśvarasya vidāraṇamabhinīya mahāścaryānvitaṃ rājānam abhāṣata rājan avasānasamaye bhavatā śubhasūcakaṃ draṣṭumucitam

janapatirekasmin puṇyadivase tīrthasnānāya pakkaṇanikaṭamārgeṇa gacchannabalayā kayācidupalālitamanupamaśarīraṃ kumāraṃ kaṃcid avalokya kutūhalākulastām apṛcchad bhāmini ruciramūrtiḥ sarājaguṇasaṃpūrtir asāvarbhako bhavadanvayasaṃbhavo na bhavati kasya nayanānandaḥ nimittena kena bhavadadhīno jātaḥ kathyatāṃ yāthātathyena tvayeti

tatra prakhyātayoretayorasaṅkhye saṃkhye vartamāne suhṛtsāhāyyakaṃ kurvāṇo nijabale sati videhe videheśvaraḥ prahāravarmā jayavatā ripuṇābhigṛhya kāruṇyena puṇyena visṛṣṭo hatāvaśeṣeṇa śūnyena sainyena saha svapuragamanamakarot
sa ca tadduhitary ambālikāyām abalāratnasamākhyātāyām atimātrābhilāṣaḥ prāṇairenaṃ na vyayūyujat
yadi kaścidastyupāyaḥ patidrohapratikriyāyai darśayāmum matirhi te paṭīyasī iti

tayedamālekhyarūpaṃ puraskṛtyāhamuktā so 'sti tādṛśo mantro yena tvamupoṣitā parvaṇi viviktāyāṃ bhūmau purohitairhutamukte saptārciṣi naktamekākinī śataṃ candanasamidhaḥ śatamagurusamidhaḥ karpūramuṣṭhiḥ paṭṭavastrāṇi ca prabhūtāni hutvā bhaviṣyasyevamākṛtiḥ
tadanu dāruvarmā vākyānītthaṃvidhāni śrāvaṃśrāvaṃ tūṣṇīṃ yadi bhiyā sthāsyati tarhi varam yadi vā daurjanyena tvayā saṃgamaṅgīkariṣyati tadā sa bhavadīyairitthaṃ vācyaḥ
tatpraviśya tatra nikṣiptaṃ tāmraśāsanaṃ śāsanaṃ vidhāturiva samādāya vidhiṃ tadupadiṣṭaṃ diṣṭavijayamiva vidhāya pātālalokādhīśvareṇa bhavatā bhavitavyam

citragupto 'pi tatra tatra saṃtapteṣvāyasastambheṣu badhyamānān atyuṣṇīkṛte vitataśarāve taile nikṣipyamāṇān laguḍairjarjarīkṛtāvayavān niśitaṭaṅkaiḥ paritakṣyamāṇānapi darśayitvā puṇyabuddhimupadiśya māmamuñcat
ebhirlabdhāḥ kākiṇīrdattvā śākaṃ dhṛtaṃ dadhi tailam āmalakaṃ ciñcāphalaṃ ca yathālābhamānaya iti
tadaśakyārambhāduparamya māturmate vartasva iti sānukampam abhihitā yadiha bhagavatpādamūlamaśaraṇam śaraṇamastu mama kṛpaṇāyā hiraṇyaretā deva eva ity udamanāyata
satyāmapi prītau na māturmātṛkāyā vā śāsanātivṛttiḥ
śrutaratnaratnāvalokasthāno 'ham idaṃ tadeva māṇikyam iti niścitya bhūdevadānanimittāṃ duravasthāmātmano janma nāmadheyaṃ yuṣmadanveṣaṇaparyaṭanaprakāraṃ cābhāṣya samayocitaiḥ saṃlāpairmaitrīmakārṣam
vipro 'sau bahutanayo vidvānnirdhanaḥ sthaviraśca dānayogya iti tasmai karuṇāpūrṇamanā ratnamadām
kiṃ karomi kva yāmi bhavadbhirna kim adarśi iti

avasareṣu puṣkalaḥ puruṣakāra ityabhidhāya bhūyaḥ smitābhiṣiktadantacchado mantragupte harṣotphullaṃ cakṣuḥ pātayāmāsa devo rājavāhanaḥ sa kila karakamalena kiṃcit saṃvṛtānano lalitavallabhārabhasadattadantakṣatavyasanavihvalādharamaṇir niroṣṭhyavarṇam ātmacaritam ācacakṣe
rājahaṃsastu praśastavītadainyasainyasametas tīvragatyā nirgatyādhikaruṣaṃ dviṣaṃ rurodha

tenābhāṣi bhūbhramaṇabalinā prāñjalinā deva śirasi devasyājñāmādāyainaṃ nirdoṣaṃ veṣaṃ svīkṛtya mālavendranagaraṃ praviśya tatra gūḍhataraṃ vartamānastasya rājñaḥ samastamudantajātaṃ viditvā pratyāgamam

parasparabaddhavairayoretayoḥ śūrayostadā tadālokanakutūhalāgatagaganacarāścaryakāraṇe raṇe vartamāne jayākāṅkṣī mālavadeśarakṣī vividhāyudhasthairyacaryāñcitasamaratulitāmareśvarasya magadheśvarasya tasyopari purā purārātidattāṃ gadāṃ prāhiṇot

eṣa hi gaṇikāmāturadhikāro yadduhiturjanmanaḥ prabhṛtyevāṅgakriyā tejobalavarṇamedhāsaṃvardhanena doṣāgnidhātusāmyakṛtā mitenāhāreṇa śarīrapoṣaṇam ā pañcamād varṣāt pitur apyanatidarśanam janmadine puṇyadine cotsavottaro maṅgalavidhiḥ adhyāpanamanaṅgavidyānāṃ sāṅgānām nṛtyagītavādyanāṭyacitrāsvādyagandhapuṣpakalāsu lipijñānavacanakauśalādiṣu ca samyagvinayanam śabdahetusamayavidyāsu vārtāmātrāvabodhanam ājīvajñāne krīḍākauśale sajīvanirjīvāsu ca dyūtakalāsvabhyantarīkaraṇam abhyantarakalāsu vaiśvāsikajanātprayatnena prayogagrahaṇam yātrotsavādiṣvādaraprasādhitāyāḥ sphītaparibarhāyāḥ prakāśanam prasaṅgavatyāṃ saṃgītādipriyāyāṃ pūrvasaṃgṛhītairgrāhyavāgbhiḥ siddhilambhanam diṅmukheṣu tattacchilpavittakair yaśaḥprakhyāpanam kārtāntikādibhiḥ kalyāṇalakṣaṇodghoṣaṇam pīṭhamardaviṭavidūṣakairbhikṣukyādibhiśca nāgarikapuruṣasamavāyeṣu rūpaśīlaśilpasaundaryamādhuryaprastāvanā yuvajanamanorathalakṣyabhūtāyāḥ prabhūtatamena śulkenāvasthāpanam svato rāgāndhāya tadbhāvadarśanonmāditāya vā jātirūpavayo'rthaśaktiśaucatyāgadākṣiṇyaśilpaśīlamādhuryopapannāya svatantrāya pradānam adhikaguṇāyāsvatantrāya prājñatamāyālpenāpi bahuvyapadeśenārpaṇam asvatantreṇa vā gandharvasamāgamena tadgurubhyaḥ śulkāpaharaṇam alābhe 'rthasya kāmasvīkṛte svāminyadhikaraṇe ca sādhanam raktasya duhitraikacāriṇīvratānuṣṭhāpanam nityanaimittikaprītidāyakatayā hṛtaśiṣṭānāṃ gamyadhanānāṃ citrairupāyairapaharaṇam adadatā lubdhaprāyeṇa ca vigṛhyāsanam pratihastiprotsāhanena lubdhasya rāgiṇastyāgaśaktisaṃdhukṣaṇam asārasya vāksaṃtakṣaṇair lokopakrośanair duhitṛnirodhanair vrīḍotpādanair anyābhiyogair avamānaiścāpavāhanam arthadair anarthapratighātibhiś cānindyair ibhyair anubaddhārthānarthasaṃśayān vicārya bhūyobhūyaḥ saṃyojanamiti

tasyā manogatam rāgodrekaṃ manmanorathasiddhyantarāyaṃ ca niśamya bāṣpapūrṇalocanāṃ tāmāśvāsya dāruvarmaṇo maraṇopāyaṃ ca vicārya vallabhām avocam taruṇi bhavadabhilāṣiṇaṃ duṣṭahṛdayamenaṃ nihantuṃ mṛdurupāyaḥ kaścin mayā cintyate
itaḥprabhṛti vigalitakalmaṣasyāsya puṇyakarmakaraṇe rucirudeṣyati

tato devasyānveṣaṇaparāyaṇo 'hamakhilakāryanimittaṃ vittaṃ niścitya bhavadanugrahāllabdhasya sādhakasya sāhāyyakaraṇadakṣaṃ śiṣyagaṇaṃ niṣpādya vindhyavanamadhye purātanapattanasthānānyupetya vividhasūcakānāṃ mahīruhāṇāmadhonikṣiptān vasupūrṇān kalaśān siddhāñjanena jñātvā rakṣiṣu paritaḥ sthiteṣu khananasādhanairutpāṭya dīnārānasaṃkhyān rāśīkṛtya tatkālāgatamanatidūre niveśitaṃ vaṇikkaṭakaṃ kaṃcid abhyetya tatra balino balīvardān goṇīśca krītvānyadravyamiṣeṇa vasu tadgoṇīsaṃcitaṃ tairuhyamānaṃ śanaiḥ kaṭakamanayam

bhūdeva etatkaṭakādhipatī rājā kasya deśasya kiṃnāmadheyaḥ kimatrāgamanakāraṇamasya iti pṛṣṭo 'bhāṣata mahīsuraḥ saumya mattakālo nāma lāṭeśvaro deśasyāsya pālayiturvīraketostanayāṃ vāmalocanāṃ nāma taruṇīratnam asamānalāvaṇyāṃ śrāvaṃ śrāvamavadhūtaduhitṛprārthanasya tasya nagarīmarautsīt
tadiyamiha pratipattiryayānuṣṭhīyamānayā manniyogatastau paritrāsyete
sā karayugena bāṣpajalam unmṛjya nijaśokaśaṅkūtpāṭanakṣamamiva māmavalokya śokahetumavocad dvijātmaja rājahaṃsamantriṇaḥ sitavarmaṇaḥ kanīyānātmajaḥ satyavarmā tīrthayātrāmiṣeṇa deśam enam āgacchat

sa vayasyagaṇādapanīya rahasi punarenam abhāṣata rājan atīte niśānte gaurīpatiḥ svapnasaṃnihito nidrāmudritalocanaṃ vibodhya prasannavadanakāntiḥ praśrayānataṃ māmavocan mātaṅga daṇḍakāraṇyāntarālagāminyās taṭinyās tīrabhūmau siddhasādhyārādhyamānasya sphaṭikaliṅgasya paścād adripatikanyāpadapaṅkticihnitasyāśmanaḥ savidhe vidherānanamiva kimapi bilaṃ vidyate
lolālako bālako 'pi śabarairādāya kutracid upānīyata
punastamādāya tāmapi vyājasuptām ullasanmadanarāgavihvalāṃ vallabhāṃ tatraivābhilikhya kācidevaṃbhūtā yuvatirīdṛśasya puṃsaḥ pārśvaśāyinyaraṇyānīprasuptena mayopalabdhā

ambujāsanā stanataṭopabhuktam uraḥsthalaṃ cedam āliṅgayitum iti priyorasi prāvṛḍiva nabhasyupāstīrṇagurupayodharamaṇḍalā prauḍhakandalīkuḍmalamiva rūḍharāgarūṣitaṃ cakṣurullāsayantī barhibarhāvalīṃ viḍambayatā kusumacandrakaśāreṇa madhukarakulavyākulena keśakalāpena sphuradaruṇakiraṇakesarakarālaṃ kadambamukulamiva kāntasyādharamaṇimadhīram ācucumba
kṛtānutāpaḥ sa kalindanandinītaṭāntakuñje viṣasāda mādhavaḥ
vyaktānurāgam iva khelatanaṅgakhedasvedāmbupūram anupūrayatu priyam vaḥ
adya utsaṅgavasadbhujaṅgakavalakleśāt iva īśācalam prāleyaplavanecchayā anusarati śrīkhaṇḍaśailānilaḥ
racaya kucayoḥ patram citram kuruṣva kapolayoḥ ghaṭaya jaghane kāñcīm añca srajā kavarībharam
tat sarvam jayadevapaṇḍitakaveḥ kṛṣṇaikatānātmanaḥ sānandāḥ pariśodhayantu sudhiyaḥ śrīgītagovindataḥ
iti ākalpavikalpatalparacanāsaṃkalpalīlāśatavyāsaktā api vinā tvayā varatanuḥ naiṣā niśām neṣyati
viśveṣām anurañjanena janayan ānandam indīvaraśreṇīśyāmalakomalaiḥ upanayan aṅgaiḥ anaṅgotsavam
kiṃca snigdharasālamaulimukulāni ālokya harṣodayāt unmīlanti kuhūḥ kuhūḥ iti kalottālāḥ pikānām giraḥ
kiṃca snigdharasālamaulimukulāni ālokya harṣodayāt unmīlanti kuhūḥ kuhūḥ iti kalottālāḥ pikānām giraḥ
śṛṅgārottarasatprameyaracanaiḥ ācāryagovardhanaspardhī ko 'pi na viśrutaḥ śrutidharaḥ dhoyī kavikṣmāpatiḥ
paulastyam jayate halam kalayate kāruṇyam ātanvate mlecchān mūrchayate daśākṛtikṛte kṛṣṇāya tubhyam namaḥ
vahasi vapuṣi viśade vasanam jaladābham halahatibhītimilitayamunābham
na kuru nitambini gamanavilambanam anusara tam hṛdayeśam
preraṇam iva karabhoru karoti gatim pratimuñca vilambam
taccaritam govinde manasijamande sakhī prāha
dhyāyan tvām aniśam japan api tava eva ālāpamantrāvalīm bhūyaḥ tvatkucakumbhanirbharaparīrambhāmṛtam vāñchati
nāsā abhyeti tilaprasūnapadavīm kundābhadanti priye prāyaḥ tvanmukhasevayā vijayate viśvam saḥ puṣpāyudhaḥ
etat tamāladalanīlatamam tamisram tatpremahemanikaṣopalatām tanoti
ittham nandanideśataḥ calitayoḥ pratyadhvakuñjadrumam rādhāmādhavayoḥ jayanti yamunākūle rahaḥkelayaḥ
sā mām drakṣyati vakṣyati smarakathām pratyaṅgam āliṅganaiḥ prītim yāsyati raṃsyate sakhi samāgatya iti cintākulaḥ
tasyāḥ eva mṛgīdṛśaḥ manasijapreṅkhatkaṭākṣāśuga śreṇījarjaritam manāk api manaḥ na adya api saṃdhukṣate
bahirapavaraṇam yāvakabharaṇam janayati hṛdi yojite
ripuḥ iva sakhīsaṃvāsaḥ ayam śikhī iva himānilaḥ viṣam iva sudhāraśmiḥ yasmin dunoti manaḥgate
ittham nandanideśataḥ calitayoḥ pratyadhvakuñjadrumam rādhāmādhavayoḥ jayanti yamunākūle rahaḥkelayaḥ
niṣpandā jaghanasthalī śithilā dorvalliḥ utkampitam vakṣaḥ mīlitam akṣi pauruṣarasaḥ strīṇām kutaḥ sidhyati
daśanapadam bhavadadharagatam mama janayati cetasi khedam
aviralanipatitamadanaśarāt iva bhavadavanāya viśālam
amandam kandarpajvarajanitacintākulatayā valadbādhām rādhām sarasam idam ūce sahacarī
api bhrāmyadbhṛṅgīraṇitaramaṇīyā na mukulaprasūtiḥ cūtānām sakhi śikhariṇī iyam sukhayati
kvacit api latākuñje guñjanmadhuvratamaṇḍalī mukharaśikhare līnā dīnā api uvāca rahaḥ sakhīm
moham tāvat ayam ca tanvi tanutām bimbādharaḥ rāgavān sadvṛttastanamaṇḍalaḥ tava katham prāṇaiḥ mama krīḍati
viśaṅkamānā ramitam kayāpi janārdanam dṛṣṭavat etat āha
kāpi kapolatale militā lapitum kimapi śrutimūle
sā mām drakṣyati vakṣyati smarakathām pratyaṅgam āliṅganaiḥ prītim yāsyati raṃsyate sakhi samāgatya iti cintākulaḥ
paśya adya priyasaṃgamāya dayitasya ākṛṣyamāṇam guṇair utkaṇṭhārtibharāt iva sphuṭat idam cetaḥ svayam yāsyāmi
madhuripuḥ aham iti bhāvanaśīlā
kṣitiḥ ativipulatare tava tiṣṭhati pṛṣṭhe dharaṇidharaṇakiṇacakragariṣṭhe
luṭhati dharaṇiśayane bahu vilapati tava nāma
vṛndāvanāntaram adīpayat aṃśujālair diksundarīvadanacandanabinduḥ induḥ
vyādhitasyauṣadhaṃ pathyaṃ nīrujasya kim auṣadhaiḥ
ātmaupamyena bhūtānāṃ dayāṃ kurvanti sādhavaḥ
ajarāmaravat prājño vidyāmarthaṃ ca cintayet
sa bhūpatir ekadā kenāpi pāṭhyamānaṃ ślokadvayaṃ śuśrāva
yan nave bhājane lagnaḥ saṃskāro nānyathā bhavet
viśvāso naiva kartavyaḥ strīṣu rājakuleṣu ca
varaṃ garbhasrāvo varam api ca naivābhigamanaṃ varaṃ jātaḥ preto varam api ca kanyāvajanitā
pañcaitāni hi sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ
ajāgalastanasyeva tasya janma nirarthakam
avaśendriyacittānāṃ hastisnānam iva kriyā
ato 'haṃ bravīmi kaṅkaṇasya tu lobhenetyādi
sarvasya hi parīkṣyante svabhāvā netare guṇāḥ
tenāsau siṃho 'kṣatakesaraḥ sukhaṃ svapiti
tathā cāsmatsannidhāne śrīmaddevapādānāṃ śaktitrayanindāṃ kṛtvā rājyam evābhilaṣati
tato mayoktam sa evāsmatprabhū rājahaṃso mahāpratāpo 'tisamarthaḥ
tenāsmadvipakṣapakṣe niyuktaḥ kathaṃ saṃgṛhyate tathā coktam
śukaḥ kiṃcid unnataśirā dattāsane upaviśya brūte bho hiraṇyagarbha tvāṃ mahārājādhirājaḥ śrīmaccitravarṇaḥ samājñāpayati yadi jīvitena śriyā vā prayojanam asti tadā satvaram āgatyāsmaccaraṇau praṇama
dhanalubdho hy asaṃtuṣṭo 'niyatātmājitendriyaḥ
nānivedya prakurvīta bhartuḥ kiṃcid api svayam
yad daṃṣṭrānakhalāṅgulapraharaṇaḥ siṃho vanaṃ gāhate tasminn eva hatadvipendrarudhirais tṛṣṇāṃ chinatty ātmanaḥ
tad ahaṃ svakīyotkarṣaṃ kiṃ na sādhayāmi ity ālocya śṛgālān āhūya tenoktam ahaṃ bhagavatyā vanadevatayā svahastenāraṇyarājye sarvauṣadhirasenābhiṣiktaḥ
dhṛṣṭaḥ pārśve vasati niyataṃ dūrataś cāpragalbhaḥ sevādharmaḥ paramagahano yoginām apy agamyaḥ
nāprāpyam abhivāñchanti naṣṭaṃ necchanti śocitum
nāsamīkṣya paraṃ sthānaṃ pūrvam āyatanaṃ tyajet
śruto hitopadeśo 'yaṃ pāṭavaṃ saṃskṛtoktiṣu
viśanti sahasā mūḍhā ye 'vicārya dviṣadbalam
bhakto guṇī śucir dakṣaḥ pragalbho 'vyasanī kṣamī
vidvān evopadeṣṭavyo nāvidvāṃs tu kadācana
varaṃ vandhyā bhāryā varam api ca garbheṣu vasatir na vāvidvān rūpadraviṇaguṇayukto 'pi tanayaḥ
varam ekaḥ kulālambī yatra viśrūyate pitā
ko dhanyo bahubhiḥ putraiḥ kuśūlāpūraṇāḍhakaiḥ
anudyogena tailāni tilebhyo nāptum arhati
ity ākarṇyātmanaḥ putrāṇām anadhigataśāstrāṇāṃ nityam unmārgagāmināṃ śāstrānanuṣṭhānenodvignamanāḥ sa rājā cintayāmāsa
parasya yuvatiṃ ramyāṃ sādaraṃ nekṣate'tra kaḥ
daridrān bhara kaunteya mā prayaccheśvare dhanam
virakteśvaracihnāni jānīyān matimān naraḥ
etat sarvaṃ śrutvā mandamatiḥ sa rathakāraḥ dhanyo 'haṃ yasyedṛśī priyavādinī svāmivatsalā ca bhāryā iti manasi nidhāya tāṃ khaṭvāṃ strīpuruṣasahitāṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā sānandaṃ nanarta
arthoṣmaṇā virahitaḥ puruṣaḥ sa eva anyaḥ kṣaṇena bhavatīti vicitram etat
tato yāvad asau dadhibhāṇḍaṃ bhūmau nidhāyordhvam avalokate tāvat tena kākavartakau dṛṣṭau
śṛgālāś ca taṃ viśiṣṭavarṇam avalokya sāṣṭāṅgapātaṃ praṇamyocuḥ yathājñāpayati devaḥ iti
tato yāvad asau pāntha utthāyordhvaṃ nirīkṣate tāvat tenāvalokito haṃsaḥ kāṇḍena hato vyāpāditaḥ
vāgdaṇḍayoś ca pāruṣyaṃ vyasanāni mahībhujām
dvīpicarmaparicchanno vāgdoṣād gardabho hataḥ
tvayā svabalotsāham avalokya sāhasaikarasikena mayopanthas teṣv api mantreṣv anavadhānaṃ vākpāruṣyaṃ ca kṛtam
na cet kathaṃ nītiśāstrakathākaumudīṃ vāgulkābhis timirayati
nāsty eva taccandanapādapasya yan nāśritaṃ duṣṭataraiś ca hiṃsraiḥ
kāmaḥ sarvātmanā heyaḥ sa ceddhātuṃ na śakyate
tatas taddhitavacanam avadhīrya mahatā bhayena vimugdha iva mantharas tajjalāśayam utsṛjya pracalitaḥ
nārikelasamākārā dṛśyante hi suhṛjjanāḥ
tan nāma jīvitam iha pravadanti tajjñāḥ kāko 'pi jīvati cirāya baliṃ ca bhuṅkte
atha kṛpayā tajjīvanāya tadvṛkṣavāsinaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ svāhārāt kiṃcit kiṃcid uddhṛtya tasmai dadati tenāsau jīvati teṣāṃ śāvakarakṣāṃ ca karoti
vipatkāle vismaya eva kāpuruṣalakṣaṇam
etad vacanaṃ śrutvā kaścit kapotaḥ sadarpam āhāḥ kim evam ucyate vṛddhasya vacanaṃ grāhyam āpatkāle hy upasthite
tatas tallāvaṇyaguṇākṛṣṭena mayāpi tatpaścājjhampo dattaḥ
mṛgeṇoktaṃ manmāṃsārthī tiṣṭhaty atraiva
asādhanā vittahīnā buddhimantaḥ suhṛnmatāḥ
āpannikaṣapāṣāṇe naro jānāti sāratām
matprabhutvaphalaṃ brūhi kadā kiṃ tad bhaviṣyati
tatphalaṃ labhate samyag rakṣite śaraṇāgate
tatsakhyā ca mayā pṛṣṭayā samākhyātameṣā kandarpakelināmno vidyādharacakravartinaḥ putrī ratnamañjarī nāma pratijñāpitā vidyate
athavā sthitir iyaṃ mandamatīnāṃ kadācicchaṅkaiva na kriyate kadācit sarvatra śaṅkā
tacchrutvā brāhmaṇo 'pi sahajadāridryād acintayad yadi satvaraṃ na gacchāmi tadānyā kaścicchrutvā śrāddhaṃ grahīṣyati
asty araṇye kaścicchṛgālaḥ svecchayā nagaropānte bhrāmyan nīlībhāṇḍe nipatitaḥ
tacchikharapradeśe ghaṇṭākarṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ prativasatīti janapravādaḥ śrūyate
sa ca taṃ gṛhītvā utthāya dhanuṣi baddhvā dhanyo 'smīty abhidhāya bhramaṇakleśāt kṣutpipāsākulaḥ svagṛhābhimukhaṃ prayātaḥ
adhunā tavānucareṇa mayā sarvathā bhavitavyam iti
bhaṅge'pi hi mṛṇālānām anubadhnanti tantavaḥ
sarvatraivaṃ vicāre ca bhojane'pi pravartatām
dātavyam iti yad dānaṃ dīyate'nupakāriṇi
eka eva suhṛd dharmo nidhane'py anuyāti yaḥ
śṛṇu ayaṃ svāmī tavopari vikṛtabuddhī rahasy uktavān saṃjīvakam eva hatvā svaparivāraṃ tarpayāmi
rājñā ca cintitamayam ekākī rājaputro mayā sūcībhedye tamasi prahitaḥ
yena svahastastham api suvarṇakaṅkaṇaṃ yasmai kasmaicid dātum icchāmi tathāpi vyāghro mānuṣaṃ khādatīti lokāpavādo durnivāraḥ
yo 'dhikād yojanaśatān paśyatīhāmiṣaṃ khagaḥ
na dharmaśāstraṃ paṭhatīti kāraṇam
tad yathā bhavitavyaṃ tathā bhavatu tāvat viśvāsam utpādyāsya samīpam upagacchāmīty ālocya tam upasṛtyābravīd ārya tvām abhivande
tṛṇena kāryaṃ bhavatīśvarāṇāṃ kim aṅgavākpāṇimatā nareṇa
tatra vardhamāno nāma vaṇiṅnivasati
na śaranmeghavat kāryaṃ vṛthaiva ghanagarjitam
kiṃtu asmin ātmasaṃdehe pravṛttir na vidheyā
atrāntare dīrgharāvo nāma jambukaḥ paribhramannāhārārthī tān mṛtān mṛgavyādhasarpaśūkarān apaśyat
janayanti sutān gāvaḥ sarvā eva gavākṛtīn
antaḥprakopaṇaṃ kuryād abhiyoktā sthirātmanaḥ
ahir ekaṃ dinaṃ yāti adya bhakṣyo dhanurguṇaḥ
kīṭo 'pi sumanaḥsaṅgād ārohati satāṃ śiraḥ
tatas teṣu cakṣurviṣayam atikrānteṣu pakṣiṣu sa vyādho nivṛttaḥ
dhanurvaṃśaviśuddho 'pi nirguṇaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati
viśanti sahasā mūḍhā ye 'vicārya dviṣadbalam

tatas tasyā rūpalāvaṇyalubdhābhyāṃ jagadghātibhyāṃ masasotsukābhyāṃ pāpatimirābhyām mamety anyonyaṃ kalahāyamānābhyāṃ pramāṇapuruṣaḥ kaścit pṛcchyatām iti matau kṛtāyāṃ sa eva bhaṭṭārako vṛddhadvijarūpaḥ samāgatya tatropasthitaḥ
śarīreṇa samaṃ nāśaṃ sarvam anyaddhi gacchati
dāridryāddhriyam eti hrīparigataḥ sattvāt paribhraśyate niḥsattvaṃ paribhūyate paribhavān nirvedam āpadyate
prakṣālanāddhi paṅkasya dūrād asparśanaṃ varam
prītyai sajjanabhāṣitaṃ prabhavati prāyo yathā cetasaḥ sadyuktyā ca pariṣkṛtaṃ sukṛtinām ākṛṣṭimantropamam
kāvyāmṛtarasāsvādaḥ saṃgamaḥ sajjanaiḥ saha
lakṣmīr uvāca yadi tvam ātmanaḥ putraṃ śaktidharaṃ dvātriṃśallakṣaṇopetaṃ bhagavatyāḥ sarvamaṅgalāyā upahārīkaroṣi tadāhaṃ punar atra suciraṃ nivasāmi
prathamam asmadāśritānām eteṣāṃ tāvat pāśāṃś chinddhi
etacchrutvā piṅgalakaḥ sabhayaṃ sāścaryaṃ matvā tūṣṇīṃ sthitaḥ
ato 'haṃ bravīmyupāyena hi yacchakyam itena hi yacchakyam ityādi
yad aśakyaṃ na tac chakyaṃ yacchakyaṃ śakyam eva tat
vīṇākarṇo nāgadantam avalokyāha katham ayaṃ mūṣikaḥ svalpabalo 'py etāvad dūram utpatati tad atra kenāpi kāraṇena bhavitavyam
purāsmin eva sarasy evaṃvidheṣv eva dhīvareṣūpasthiteṣu matsyatrayeṇālocitam
nīceṣūpakṛtaṃ rājan bālukāsv iva mūtritam
yuddha eva yuvayor niyama ity abhihite sati sādhūktam aneneti kṛtvānyonyatulyavīryau samakālam anyonyaghātena vināśam upāgatau
kākatālīyavat prāptaṃ dṛṣṭvāpi nidhim agrataḥ
nagnatvaṃ nīlakaṇṭhasya mahāhiśayanaṃ hareḥ
saṃyojayati vidyaiva nīcagāpi naraṃ sarit
pañcatantrāt tathānyasmād granthād ākṛṣya likhyate
tatra citragrīva uvāca mitra mā maivaṃ kuru
kāṇena cakṣuṣā kiṃ vā cakṣuḥ pīḍaiva kevalam
sarvadravyeṣu vidyaiva dravyam āhur anuttamam
seveva mānam akhilaṃ jyotsneva tamo jareva lāvaṇyam
seveva mānam akhilaṃ jyotsneva tamo jareva lāvaṇyam
seveva mānam akhilaṃ jyotsneva tamo jareva lāvaṇyam
ayaṃ nijaḥ paro veti gaṇanā laghucetasām
śuka tvam evānena saha tatra gatvāsmadabhilaṣitaṃ brūhi
tatas tenāsau rājadarśanaṃ kārito brūte deva yadi mayā sevakena prayojanam asti tadāsmadvartanaṃ kriyatām
viṣṇuśarmā kathayati tatas tena rājahaṃsena uktam kenāsmaddurge nikṣipto 'gniḥ kiṃ pārakyeṇa kiṃ vāsmaddurgavāsinā kenāpi vipakṣaprayuktena
saṃlāpitānāṃ madhurair vacobhir mithyopacāraiś ca vaśīkṛtānām
rājovāca bho bhoḥ paṇḍitāḥ śrūyatāṃ mama vacanam
yathodayagirer dravyaṃ saṃnikarṣeṇa dīpyate
hīnasevā na kartavyā kartavyo mahadāśrayaḥ
anye badarikākārā bahir eva manoharāḥ
ādyā hāsyāya vṛddhatve dvitīyādriyate sadā
marusthalyāṃ yathā vṛṣṭiḥ kṣudhārte bhojanaṃ tathā
na ca vidyāgamaḥ kaścit taṃ deśaṃ parivarjayet
ātmā nadī saṃyamapuṇyatīrthā satyodakā śīlataṭā dayormiḥ
asti gautamasya maharṣes tapovane mahātapā nāma muniḥ
nadyadrivanadurgeṣu yatra yatra bhayaṃ nṛpa
tato 'sau yāvad asmaddurgadvārarodhaṃ na karoti tāvan nadyadrivanavartmasu tadbalāni hantuṃ sārasādayaḥ senāpatayo niyujyantām
dhātrīva jananī paścāt tadā śokasya kaḥ kramaḥ
sa āha śṛṇu kim anurakto virakto vā mayi svāmīti jñāsyāmi
tatrāgatya svayam eva paśyatu svāmīty uktvā tasmin kūpajale tasya siṃhasyaiva pratibimbaṃ darśitavān
'pi śauṇḍikīhaste vāruṇīty abhidhīyate
diṅmārgāṇāṃ viśodhitvaṃ pattikarma pracakṣate
ṣaḍdoṣāḥ puruṣeṇeha hātavyā bhūtim icchatā
ato 'haṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantare bhavatputrān nītiśāstrābhijñān kariṣyāmi
punar guṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ svasaṃjñayā vidhāne niyamārtham
taparakaraṇaṃ tv iha sarvārtham
halaḥ iti kim titaucchatram saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ iti lopaḥ syāt
ekaśca asāvacca ekāc nipāto ya ekāc āṅvarjitaḥ sa pragṛhyasañjño bhavati
mukhagrahaṇaṃ kim anusvārasyaiva hi syāt
chāndasam etad evaikam udāharaṇam asme indrābṛhaspatī iti
dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇām iti dvandve ceti nityaṃ pratiṣedho bhavati
teneha na bhavati śatāni sahasrāṇi
śākalyasyetau anārṣe iti vartate
taddhitāntaḥ śabdo 'sarvavibhaktiḥ avyayasañjño bhavati
dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇām iti dvandve ceti nityaṃ pratiṣedho bhavati
rephoṣmaṇāṃ savarṇā na santi
bhinnajātīyair ajbhir avyavahitaḥ śliṣṭoccāritā halaḥ saṃyogasaṃjñā bhavanti
yathā kartavyam ity atra pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati evam aupagavam ity atra api yathā syāt
sarvaśabdaḥ ādir yeṣāṃ tānīmāni sarvādīni sarvanāmasaṃjñāni bhavanti
jusi sārvadhātukādiguṇeṣu ikāṅgaṃ viśeṣyate
vakṣyati sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ aṅgasya guṇa iti
ulmukāni iva me 'mī svā jñātayo bharatarṣabha
gakāro 'pi atra cartvabhūto nirdiśyate
kṛd yo makārāntaḥ ejantaś ca tadantaṃ śabdarūpam avyayasañjñaṃ bhavati
mṛjer ajādau saṃkrame vibhāṣā vṛddhir iṣyate
vṛddhipradeśāḥ sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu ityevamādayaḥ
sarvaśabdaḥ ādir yeṣāṃ tānīmāni sarvādīni sarvanāmasaṃjñāni bhavanti
san sanāt sanat tiras ete ādyudāttāḥ paṭhyante
bhūryādīnāṃ nivṛttyarthaṃ saṅkhyāsañjñā vidhīyate
dārūpāś catvāro dhātavaḥ dhārūpau ca dvau dābdaipau varjayitvā ghusañjñakā bhavanti
antaram ity etacchabdarūpaṃ vibhāṣā jasi sarvanāmasañjñaṃ bhavati bahiryoge upasaṃvyāne ca gamyamāne

kim idaṃ śi iti jaśśasoḥ ṣiḥ iti śiḥ ādeśaḥ
īṣadarthe kriyāyoge maryādābhividhau ca yaḥ
vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñātvena vidhīyate pratyekam ādaicāṃ varṇānāṃ sāmānyena tadbhāvitānām atadbhāvitānāṃ ca
īdantam ūdantaṃ ca śabdarūpaṃ saptamyarthe vartamānaṃ pragṛhyasañjñaṃ bhavati
īdantam ūdantaṃ ca śabdarūpaṃ saptamyarthe vartamānaṃ pragṛhyasañjñaṃ bhavati

ktvātosuṅkasunaḥ kṛnmakārāntaḥ sandhyakṣarāntaḥ avyayībhāvaś ca
vacaneṣu ca sarveṣu yanna vyeti tadavyayam
guṇavṛddhī svasaṃjñayā vidhīyete tatra ikaḥ iti etadupasthitaṃ draṣṭavyam
vacanādyatra dīrghatvaṃ tatra api sarasī yadi
īdādīnāṃ pragṛhyatve maṇīvādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ

vṛddhir iṭo na sambhavati iti laghūpadhaguṇasyātra pratiṣedhaḥ

anāṅ iti kim ā udakāntāt odakāntāt
prayatanaṃ prayatnaḥ spṛṣṭatādir varṇaguṇaḥ
dvivacanam iti kim kumāryatra
adasaḥ iti kim śamyatra
maṇīvoṣṭrasya lambete priyau vatsatarau mama
īdādīnāṃ pragṛhyatve maṇīvādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ

diggrahaṇaṃ kim na bahuvrīhau iti pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyati tatra na jñāyate kva vibhāṣā kva pratiṣedhaḥ iti
diggrahaṇe punaḥ kriyamāṇe jñāyate digupadiṣṭasamāse vibhāṣā anyatra pratiṣedhaḥ iti
tatra diksaṅkhye sañjñāyām ity anuvṛttes tataḥ saṅkhyāpūrvasya dvigusañjñāyāṃ śūrpād añ anyatarasyām iti añ ṭhañ ca
diggrahaṇe punaḥ kriyamāṇe jñāyate digupadiṣṭasamāse vibhāṣā anyatra pratiṣedhaḥ iti
digupadiṣṭe samāse bahuvrīhau vibhāṣā sarvādīni sarvanāmasañjñāni bhavanti
taparakaraṇam īdūtau saptamīty eva lupte 'rthagrahaṇād bhavet
riṣerhisārthasya vicpratyayalopa udāharaṇaṃ reṭ iti
atra anukāryānukaraṇayoḥ bhedasya avivakṣitatvāt asatyarthavattve vibhaktirna bhavati
etam ātaṃ ṅitaṃ vidyād vākyasmaraṇayor aṅit
ekaśca asāvacca ekāc nipāto ya ekāc āṅvarjitaḥ sa pragṛhyasañjño bhavati
ṣaṭpradeśāḥ ṣaḍbhyo luk ity evamādayaḥ
ṣakārāntā nakārāntā ca yā saṅkhyā sā ṣaṭsañjñā bhavati
āṭaḥ paro yo ac aci ca pūrvo ya āṭ tayoḥ pūrvaparayoḥ āḍacoḥ sthāne vṛddhir ekādeśo bhavati
ahaṃ tatraiva caiṣyāmi dāsyāmyasimimaṃ ca te
kṛtavarmā sutāṃ tasmai rājñe mūrtim ivaindavīm
sa janairdadṛśe tatra śikhare jvalitauṣadhau
tato dṛṣṭvā sutaiśvaryaṃ kṛtārthaḥ sa tapovanam
aucityānvayarakṣā ca yathāśakti vidhīyate
alaṃkaravatī cātha tataḥ śaktiyaśā bhavet
kathārasāvighātena kāvyāṃśasya ca yojanā
tasyābhavacca vikṛtā vapuṣīvāśaye 'pyalam
pathi tasyābhavad bhūmir upabhukteva bhūpateḥ
so 'pi tenābhavadbālo dhūsarāṅgaḥ pṛthūdaraḥ
dṛṣṭvā cādṛṣṭapūrvaṃ tat tasyā netrāmṛtaṃ vapuḥ
vetālādhiṣṭhitās tasmin praharanti sma muṣṭibhiḥ
kiṃcaitanme kapālātma jagaddevi kare sthitam
vyāḍinaivopanīto 'haṃ vedārhatvaṃ mamecchatā
tadiha praviśetyuktvā ceṭyastāstaṃ tathāvidham
yogī bhūtvā praviśyedaṃ puṣpadantastadāśṛṇot
viśrāntas tatra cākleśāt prāpya karpūrasaṃbhavam
gacchan gopālarājasya praṇāmaṃ tasya nākarot
ity evākhyāpya samayaṃ prāptāyāṃ rajanau ca tān
strītvaṃ kṣībatvam ekāntaḥ puṃso lābho 'niyantraṇā
hriyamāṇāṃ jalaughena sāgarasthāmiva śriyam
vipanne pannage pūrvaṃ mantrauṣadhibalādayam
āruhya tasthau śākhāyāṃ pattraughacchannavigrahā
sthāpayāmāsa ratnaughaṃ taṃ babandha ca pakṣiṇam
so 'pi muktas tato 'paśyan gatiṃ kāṃcid vaṇiksutaḥ
tato 'pratihatau vīrau militānekapārthivau
nāgārjuno 'punarjanmā gato buddhasamāṃ gatim
adyāpi na ca niryānti prāṇā me 'pāpakarmaṇaḥ
tataḥ sa vikramādityo 'siddhakāryo vyacintayat
śīlavatyāḥ svasā hy eṣā nirdarpā nāsatī bhavet
pūrṇakoṣo dadhau satyāṃ vatseśo rājarājatām
āvirbhūya mayā coktau varaḥ ko 'pyarthyatāmiti
saṃdhyānuttotsave tārāḥ kareṇoddhūya vighnajit
kiṃ na bhartā mamāhūtastvayā tātocyatāmiti
pāpe prayāhi mānuṣyaṃ prāpya cāyonijāṃ sutām
ityuktvā virate śaṃbhau devī kopākulābravīt
kiṃ na bhartā mamāhūtastvayā tātocyatāmiti
anyac ca mālyavān api nagaravare supratiṣṭhitākhye saḥ
tapasārādhitā devī svapnādeśena sā ca tam
jānāti hi jayāpyetaditi ceśvaramabhyadhāt
śrutvaitatsahasā serṣyaṃ śarvavarmā kilāvadat
kathaṃ prasādayasi taṃ vahnim aprayato 'śuciḥ
so 'śūdrānnabhug ekena vaṇijā guṇavāniti
viśvāsya dīkṣitaṃ kṛtvā daṃpatī tau sahocatuḥ
gatvā ca svoṣmaṇā so 'gnir nivārya suratācchivam
mayā tato vibhidyoruṃ raktabindurnipātitaḥ
ityuktvā tvaritaṃ snātvā sa carṣirbhoktumāyayau
devarṣe nandanodyānavartī rājā purūravāḥ
pratyarpya tasmai sa yayau nāradarṣir adarśanam
tatsamakṣaṃ ca tasyarṣeḥ kuśenābhūtkarakṣatiḥ
tataḥ prāganurāgeṇa rañjitaḥ svāntavānmama
vāgantarikṣādatha māṃ tanmanye siddhirasti te
sajīvam iva taccitraṃ vākceṣṭārahitaṃ tv abhūt
matiṃ cakre ca tāṃ tasmai dātuṃ prāgditsitāṃ sutām
prāpnuyādeva pūrvaṃ hi divyā vāgevamabravīt
jātayośca tayorevaṃ prāgjanmasmarator dvayoḥ
sarvasya jantoḥ prāgjātiṃ yā syājjijñāsitā tava
prākkarmopārjitaṃ jantoḥ sarvam eva śubhāśubham
mīlitākṣaḥ prasāryāṅgaṃ pata bhūmāv avāṅmukhaḥ
mene kṛtārtham anyasmin puṃsyarthe ca parāṅmukhī
sa ca prākpratipannaḥ sann upetyainam abhāṣata
tallajjāsadanaṃ vidhāya vidadhe vatseśvare bhartari prākprauḍhapraṇayāvabaddhamapi tadbhaktyekatānaṃ manaḥ
jagau jayā pratīhārī strīṣu vāksaṃyamaḥ kutaḥ
iti vāksudhayā sā mām ānandya viratābhavat
iti vāgudabhūddivyā puṣpavṛṣṭyā samaṃ tadā
ityuktvā virate tasmindivyā vāgudabhūdiyam
sādhu sādhu śamaṃ tvetaddivyā vāgudabhūttataḥ
vaṇikputreṇa ca prāgvat tato 'pi sa nivāritaḥ
sakhi jātismarāyā me prāgvṛttaṃ śṛṇu kāraṇam
vijñāyamānaṃ nirjīva iti vāgvirahātparam
indrotsavaṃ kadācicca prekṣituṃ nirgatā vayam
kvacicca vaṇijāṃ madhye vaṇigeko 'bravīdidam
tatas tathā taṃ kurvāṇaṃ tacchidreṇaiva tatkṣaṇam
tacca te 'vaśyakartavyaṃ kāryaṃ kiṃciddhi vidyate
kathāmākhyāhi me kāṃciddhṛdayasya vinodinīm
maddhaste kiṃcid apy asyā deva nāstīty abhāṣata
asmajjananyośca tataḥ sphuṭitaṃ hṛdayaṃ śucā
etajjāyā ca sā jātā pāṭalī nāma bhūpateḥ
kathaṃcijjīvitaṃ dadhre punaḥ saṃgamavāñchayā
vetti tajjñātavānevamasau vararuciḥ katham
ramyāṃ kāṃcitkathāṃ brūhi devādya mama nūtanām
mālyavantaṃ ca vijñaptiṃ kurvāṇaṃ tatkṛte gaṇam
alakṣito yogavaśātpraviveśa sa tatkṣaṇāt
ityuvāca giraṃ so 'tha tvatkarṇaviṣasūcikām
tataḥ pratyabravītsā taṃ yadyevaṃ tatkhagāminā
tatkhedād atha vijñapya yācito bhairavo mayā
śanaiḥ so 'pi vipatkhinnaḥ sthātum icchan svakarmaṇi
tallajjāsadanaṃ vidhāya vidadhe vatseśvare bhartari prākprauḍhapraṇayāvabaddhamapi tadbhaktyekatānaṃ manaḥ
sā tallocanalāvaṇyahṛtacittā tam abravīt
vyāḍināmā tayoreko manmātuḥ praṇato 'bravīt
avocattau ca manmātā he putrau nātra saṃśayaḥ
adya yuṣmanmukhājjñātvā paritoṣaśca me paraḥ
etannimittaṃ yuddhaṃ nau yo balī sa hared iti
athāgatya samākhyātaṃ tatsakhyā mannibandhanam
tataś cāham ihāyāto buddhvā tvannāma tanmukhāt
ahaṃ vyāḍiḥ samutpanno matpitāstaṃ gatastataḥ
tvatprasādādgataprāyaḥ sa śāpo me śarīrataḥ
yo yadvapati bījaṃ hi labhate so 'pi tatphalam
taṃ kadācitsamutpannavisrambhā rahasi priyā
yaṣṭyā yallikhyate kiṃcitsatyaṃ saṃpadyate hi tat
tacca tatsaṃcayāyaiva mayā soḍhaṃ tava priye
kālena svargate tasminsabhārye te ca tatsutāḥ
ataḥ śyālaḥ sa te kiṃcittvadguṇaiḥ samavāpyate
tacchokādindradattasya pitā yāto mahāpatham
mama tu tvaccharāghātaparyantaṃ tadanantaram
tataḥ kṣutkṣāmavapuṣoḥ śanair nāvavasīdatoḥ

bṛhatkathāyāḥ sārasya saṃgrahaṃ racayāmyaham
tasyāḥ svalpāṃ kathāmevaṃ śivaḥ saṃpratyavarṇayat
kṛtvā mūrkhāya viprāya dadatyeva kṛte hi tāḥ
dadāmyetadanarghaṃ vo ratnālaṃkaraṇaṃ nijam
nṛtyatyeṣa piturmittraṃ tava nando naṭaḥ suta
ahaṃ tvayatnāditi yo hasatīva svakāntibhiḥ
itīha dhanadenāsya śāpānto vihitastadā
kiṃ te priyaṃ karomīti babhāṣe śaśiśekharaḥ
ityukte śaṃbhunā tatra śroṣyāmīti sakautuke
rājā yuṣmākamasmīti vaktyasmānanuśāsti ca
ityuktvā virate śaṃbhau devī kopākulābravīt
ityuvāca giraṃ so 'tha tvatkarṇaviṣasūcikām
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi bahūnyākramya tiṣṭhati
ityādiṣṭaḥ sa tenaiva saharṣo 'yamihāgataḥ
supratīkābhidho yakṣaḥ kāṇabhūtyākhyayā sthitaḥ
śāpānto hīdṛśastasyā vicitro vidhiyogataḥ
itīdṛṃśi bhavantyeva kāryāṇi tad idaṃ mama
ratnānīdṛṃśi bhūyāṃsi na bhavantyeva bhūtale
ityūcuraparāste dve dṛṣṭvā devyau parasparam
hataḥ putraka ityūcus tatpitṝṇāṃ puro mṛṣā
jamadagnyarṣiṇā dṛṣṭā sthitāsau tatra cāśrame
āgatya so 'pi tāmevamekānte vaṇigabravīt
buddhvā ca so 'nnadātāsya vaṇiganyaiḥ sahāyayau
tadyathā sa bhiṣagbuddhyā cakre rājahitaṃ tathā
tatheti pratipadyaitadgatvā so 'tha vaṇigbhayāt
sa rājātra vaṇigbhāryāṃ pravāsasthitabhartṛkām
vaṇigbhṛtyasya daśanairjihvāṃ mūḍhadhiyo 'chinat
durvārāstaṃ vaṇigbhṛtyaṃ yasya skandhe 'hamāsitaḥ
tasyai guṇavarāyai sa cūrṇamiśraṃ bhiṣagdadau
pratyāvartiṣṭa sa tato bhiṣagdeśaṃ nijaṃ prati
so 'rthalobho vaṇigdharmāllobhādbhṛtyeṣv aviśvasan
tacchrutvā vaṇijaṃ taṃ ca parivrāḍevamabravīt
lajjite 'tha vaṇiggrāme rājā saṃjātavismayaḥ
sa parivrāḍ vivṛtavān vaṇikkanyābhilāṣukaḥ
vaṇikkarmakaro 'bhūvaṃ devadāso 'ham eva saḥ
gatvā taṃ ca patiṃ tatra vaṇiṅmadhye dadarśa sā
iti taiḥ sā vaṇikputraiḥ pṛṣṭā pravrājikābravīt
ity avocat krudhā kaṃcid vaṇikputraṃ viśākhilaḥ
iha sthitā vaṇikputrāstarhi tānānayāmi te
bhiṣagrūpeṇa devo 'yaṃ puṇyair naḥ ko 'py upāgataḥ
tathaiva ca punaḥ sāyaṃ dvitīyo 'pi vaṇiksutaḥ
vaṇiksutānāṃ caiteṣāṃ svagṛhaṃ sthitaye dadau
vicintya guhasenaṃ te catvāro 'pi vaṇiksutāḥ
pravrāṭsaṃbandhinas tāṃś ca sarṣapān bhūmibhedinaḥ
tatrasthaṃ ca tamabhyāgādujjayinyā vaṇiktadā
yāvatsa paścime yāme vaṇiktatrāgato 'bhavat
ānāyyāśokadattaṃ taṃ śrutaṃ tasmād vaṇigvarāt
svaceṭikābhiḥ sahitā vaṇigveṣaṃ cakāra sā
kā te vijñaptir astīti vaṇigveṣām uvāca tām
sa cāgatya vaṇigyāvatsabhṛtyaḥ pāśabandhanam
tadā sa vaṇigārtaḥ sanskandadāso 'bravīdidam
tasyāṃ ca dhanadattākhyo vaṇigāsīnmahādhanaḥ
jīvadattābhidhastāvatko 'py atra vaṇigāyayau
acintayad dhigastvetān kravyādān prāṇighātinaḥ
yathā mūlaṃ tathaivaitanna manāgapyatikramaḥ
mantrasvāmyākhyam abhyarthya vidyāḥ samyagadhītavān
kṣatriyasyājigīṣasya dhigbāhū dhik ca yauvanam
tathā ca vṛtraśatrau prāgbrahmahatyāpalāyite
yaugandharāyaṇena prāgdūtaṃ saṃpreṣya bodhitaḥ
vācā tenopakośā ca prāgdharmabhaginī kṛtā
samyagevamabhidhāya tatkṣaṇaṃ vatsarājamudayasya bhāvinaḥ
mayā kaliṅgasenāyā garbhaḥ prāggarbhaśayyayā
so 'haṃ snāntīmapaśyaṃ prāggaṅgāyāmṛṣikanyakām
abhūd dakṣiṇabhūmau prāggokarṇākhye pure nṛpaḥ
rājanvakṣyāmi te kiṃcitpratīkṣasva manāgiti
prāṅmanthād arṇavasyeva kamalā kukṣikoṭare
tāto 'yam āgato 'treti drāgratnaprabhayodite
śrutaṃ mama syāt kvāpīti prāguktaṃ deva me tvayā
sāpi saṃmohya pitaraṃ prāgvad rūpaśikhā patim
mayā ca prāgvilokya tvāṃ purā pitṛgṛhe sthitām
samyagvivekapadavīṃ prāpya vatseśvaro 'bravīt
sa rājānaṃ samāśvāsya sāvadhiṃ prāgyathā śrutam
prekṣyo lagno 'nukūlaḥ prāgyena syādetayoḥ śubham
evaṃ jātāḥ pṛthagyogācchāpāntaḥ saiṣa cādya naḥ
tato 'dhvani manākcheṣe jāte tīvratapaḥkṛśaḥ
evaṃ kṛte tvamasmākaṃ svāmī niyama eṣa naḥ
athāhaṃ rājakāryāṇi cintayannavasaṃ sukham
tadetāmaiśvarīṃ māyāṃ kiṃ jānannapi muhyasi
tatkaraṅkairvṛto jīvannatiṣṭhatsa ca kevalaḥ
rājannalaṃ viṣādena jīvanvararuciḥ sthitaḥ
adhyāpayitum asmāṃśca pravṛtto 'bhūdasau tataḥ
tatra śrāntāgatāyāmbhaḥ śītalaṃ caṇakāṃśca tān
praviśaṃśca cirāttatra nagare supratiṣṭhite
āsīcca jāgradevātra sa rātrāvavalokayan
na putrāḥ sāhasaṃ kāryaṃ jīvanneṣyati vaḥ sakhā
devīṃ vāsavadattāṃ tāṃ sāntvayannevam abravīt
bhūyāsaṃ tava śuśrūṣāparo 'haṃ bhagavanniti
so 'tha kopena cāṇakyo jvalanniva samantataḥ
sītkārasīkarairanyāḥ kalpayanniva pātu vaḥ
ataḥ pitāmahaḥ proktaḥ sa pumāñjagati priye
taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃsmarañjātiṃ yadā tasmai kathāmimām
aṣṭame 'hni mayā tasmiñjite tatsamanantaram
dehadāhātsthire tasmiñjāte nirgatya me dadau
rājye me bhuṅkṣva bhogāṃstvaṃ bhuktvā māṃ mā sma gā iti
bhramaṃstatra ca sa prāṃśuṃ nyagrodhatarumaikṣata
tena tasmiṃstirobhūte haste rājātivismayāt
kṣīṇaḥ śāpaḥ sa te rājannudayādrau ca sā sthitā
sanirvedaḥ sa tapase toṣayiṣyannumāpatim
vidhāsyannudyogaṃ tvaritamatha saṃmantrya sacivaiḥ sa cakre kauśāmbīṃ prati gamanabuddhiṃ narapatiḥ
evaṃ rumaṇvatoktaḥ sannāha yaugandharāyaṇaḥ
tataḥ kṛtābhiṣekaḥ sannāruhya jayakuñjaram
prātaśca matsyahāsasya hetuṃ rājñe nyavedayam
prātastayā ca vijñapto rājā cārānvyasarjayat
punastaddarśanotkaṇṭhā tathāsya vavṛdhe tataḥ
anyedyuranujñāpya prāṇadharastaṃ nṛpaṃ sa sakuṭumbaḥ
anyedyuratha vatseśaṃ mantrī yaugandharāyaṇaḥ
mañjūṣāyāṃ sa ceṭībhirdattaṃ ca bahirargalam
rājñī takṣaśilāyāṃ sā tārādattā śanairabhūt
āpūryata tato 'nyaiśca śanairbuddhvā vaṇigvaraiḥ
āliliṅga sa tāṃ kāntāṃ prābudhyata tataśca sā
tataścukopa girijā nāpūrvaṃ varṇitaṃ tvayā
anyedyurdaityakanyāstāḥ kṛtvāgre tatpuraṃ yayau
so 'tha tāmavadadrājā bahirdvāri dvijaḥ sthitaḥ
deva dordaṇḍadarpeṇa śastravidyāmadena ca
svayaṃ ca pādacārī sansa śanairdayitānvitaḥ
ityālocya śanairetya tasya suptasya pakṣiṇaḥ
anyedyurmantrimukhyau tau dūtaṃ vyasṛjatāṃ nijam
śanairupagatāṃ tāṃ ca cakṣuṣā premavarṣiṇā
sāsyāḥ kaliṅgasenāyāḥ śanairupasasarpa ca
śāpāntaṃ prati śarvāṇī śanairvacanamabravīt
atha vāsavadattā sā śanairvatseśvaraṃ prati
anyedyurāsthānagato jagāda sa ca pārśvagān
tacchrutvā bahirālokya śunīṃ tāṃ rudatīmiva
śanairādatta kanyāṃ ca punaḥ saṃgamakāraṇam
śanairāpūryamāṇena vapuṣā dhanuṣā ca saḥ
eṣa śrutadharo jāto vidyāṃ varṣādavāpsyati
tadbrūhi nijavṛttāntaṃ janmanaḥ prabhṛti prabho
varṣopavarṣau tadbuddhvā sādhvīṃ tāmabhyanandatām
yadbodhayanti suptāṃ janmani yūnāṃ tadeva phalam
uktaṃ mayā dadāmyeva yadbhartrā sthāpitaṃ dhanam
yadbhavānī sutābhāvaṃ trijagajjananī gatā
cintā me putra yadbhāryā nānurūpā tava kvacit
avadacca candramauliḥ kauśāmbītyasti yā mahānagarī
śūlaṃ trijagato 'pyasya hṛdayāccitramuddhṛtam
tacca tatsaṃcayāyaiva mayā soḍhaṃ tava priye
satyaḥ pravādo yacchidreṣvanarthā yānti bhūritām
kiṃcaitanme kapālātma jagaddevi kare sthitam
kapāleṣu śmaśāneṣu kasmāddeva ratistava
tasyāṃ tasmāddvijavarādeṣa jāto 'smi śāpataḥ
hṛdayāddhīratāṃ cāpi samaṃ kanyā mumoca sā
sa mahyaṃ bhavatīṃ prādāddharmādibhyo 'parāśca tāḥ
gaganādevam udabhūd aśarīrā sarasvatī
tasyāntamīkṣituṃ prāyādeka ūrdhvamadho 'paraḥ
tadenaṃ dehi gacchāvo vidyādraviṇasiddhaye
atha dūraṃ kṣaṇādgatvā dadarśa nagarīṃ śubhām
tadgṛhītvāyamāyāto mayā nirbhartsito bhṛśam
bhokṣyase dhuri cānyeṣāmehi tāvadgṛhaṃ mama
itthaṃ tavāpi śuddhiḥ syāttiṣṭha tāvadgṛhe mama
kṣetreṣu varṣati tadānuguṇaṃ narendre tasmin dhvanadghanamṛdaṅganināditāyām
lasadghṛṇe ca bhūyaḥ sā dāśendratanayābravīt
sakṛcchrutamayaṃ bālaḥ sarvaṃ vai dhārayeddhṛdi
etaddhiraṇyaguptasya vacaḥ śṛṇuta devatāḥ
tatkṣaṇaṃ kiṃ na kuryāddhi prasādaḥ pārameśvaraḥ
acintayacca śaktiḥ syāddhantuṃ vararuciṃ na me
pāpo 'yam asmājjātena kiṃ dehena mamāmunā
yadbhavānī sutābhāvaṃ trijagajjananī gatā
pañcabhirmilitaiḥ kiṃ yajjagatīha na sādhyate
kramāllāvāṇakaṃ prāpya vatseśo vasatiṃ nijām
apauruṣakṛtaṃ loke naiva syāllāghavaṃ ca vaḥ
kālo vidyullatājihvo garjan parjanyarākṣasaḥ
yaṣṭyā yallikhyate kiṃcitsatyaṃ saṃpadyate hi tat
śaśāṅkavatyapi tathā tataḥ syānmadirāvatī
svato me nāsti vijñānaṃ kiṃtu śarvānmayā śrutam
yāvatkiṃcidgatā tāvanniruddhā sā purodhasā
akarodrājakāryāṇi punaḥ samprāpya mantritām
avocadrākṣasī rājñaḥ sarvā rājñyo 'pi viplutāḥ
etadbuddhyā bhavedrājyaṃ sthiraṃ divyānubhāvayā
varṣasya veśma vasubhiḥ sa kilādareṇa tatkālameva samapūrayadunnataśrīḥ
sarasvatyāś ca lakṣmyāś ca tadupādhyāya kathyatām
puṣpadanta pravaktāsi tadā śāpādvimokṣyase
ehi rājñaḥ sakhe nandādyācituṃ gurudakṣiṇām
tadyathā tilako jñātastathā sarvamidaṃ mayā
rājñe so 'pi tadākarṇya kiṃ bhavedityacintayat
tvaṃ ca saṃprati tiṣṭheha yāvadāyāti te 'ntikam
nāvadhīdathavā kiṃ hi na bhavedīśvarecchayā
etacchrutvā vacaḥ śambhoḥ saharṣo 'ham ihāgataḥ
tacchrutvā pratipede 'sya vihitānunayo haraḥ
ujjayinyāṃ śmaśāne yacchṛṇu tatkathayāmi te
yadūcurgaṇakāstasya tatsa naiva vyacārayat
kramādṛkṣe prasupte ca rājaputre ca jāgrati
visrambhādṛkṣavākyena rājaputro 'tha suptavān
tasyāḥ svalpāṃ kathāmevaṃ śivaḥ saṃpratyavarṇayat
ahaṃ tvayatnāditi yo hasatīva svakāntibhiḥ
na spṛśāmyapi jātvetānahaṃ kutanayāniti
kiṃtvekaṃ kautukaṃ me 'sti kathyatāṃ kena hetunā
tasmāt saṃbhakṣayatvekaḥ pratyahaṃ sajalānamūn
tato 'bravīdguṇāḍhyo 'pi śṛṇvetatkathayāmi te
uktā praṇamya vakti sma dayāṃ devaḥ karotviti
sīdantasteṣu gṛhyante khāteṣviva vanadvipāḥ
rājā tvihendradattākhyaḥ sakhā vadhyo na me dvijaḥ
tathā ca tadgataṃ sarvaṃ śṛṇvidaṃ kathayāmi te
lokaḥ paśūpahāreṇa prīṇāti varadāmimām
so 'pi tenābhavadbālo dhūsarāṅgaḥ pṛthūdaraḥ
kampo vāsavadattāyā hṛdaye tūdapadyata
devyā naivāparāddhaṃ te pūrṇā tūpakṛtiḥ kṛtā
ityālocya pradhāvyaiva keśeṣvākṛṣya tasya saḥ
ahaṃ tvātmānameveha hanmi mūrkhamimaṃ paśum
śobhanāḥ santi te rājannaḍaghāsāśca sugrahāḥ
rājanvāsavadattāṃ te dṛṣṭvā hanta smṛtaṃ mayā
athaityārūḍhagovāṭā sā gatvā nabhasā niśi
sa tu sarvātmanā naicchad arthyamāno 'pi viplavam
sāpi tadvismayāviṣṭā gatvā girisutāgrataḥ
devi tvaṃ ca tathānyāśca bahvyo 'jāyanta kanyakāḥ
śrutvātha gatvā bhāryāyai jayāyai so 'pyavarṇayat
iha kāmacaratvācca tvāmapaśyamahaṃ tadā
puruṣas tena mūrdhānam athaitasyāham achidam
varjitas tv aham evaikas tato 'pṛcchyata sa tvayā
tathaiva tanmayā sarvaṃ paṭhitaṃ paśyatos tayoḥ
yathā mūlaṃ tathaivaitanna manāgapyatikramaḥ
pitṛbhiste prayuktāḥ smaḥ svarṇaṃ dattveti cābruvan
tvayā ca puṣpadantasya sa eveti smara priye
neha kaiścit praveṣṭavyam ity uktena tayā svayam
ekā kuntī dvitīyā ca mādrī nāma mahaujasaḥ
māṃ muñcata karomyatra nodbhedaṃ yāmi dūrataḥ
tvadduḥkhaṃ notsahe draṣṭum ity uktvāntarhitābhavat
kimapi tadavalokya tatra citraṃ pramadavaśānna paraṃ tadopavarṣaḥ
yukto divyena bhogena tvāmupaiṣyati cācirāt
athālāpe kṛte vṛtte gāndharvodvāhakarmaṇi
ityuktvā sāvayoḥ sādhvī kathāmetāmavarṇayat
tapasārādhitā devī svapnādeśena sā ca tam
ākarṣikākhyāṃ tasyāṃ ca nabhaso 'vatatāra saḥ
atredṛśāni jāyante hemābjāni samantataḥ
kiṃtu kṛtvedṛśaṃ karma yadanenātra supyate
kathaṃ syān mānuṣāgamyaṃ jñānaṃ śāstraṃ vinedṛśam
athocuste praveśo 'tra puṃso 'nyasyāsti na prabho
tatas te nijayorbhartrorubhe gatvā mṛṣocatuḥ
sā ca tena samānāya magadheṣu maharddhaye
sthānasthāneṣu babhrāma śaktidevo maharddhiṣu
naravāhanadatto 'tra sapatnīkair maharṣibhiḥ
amoghaṃ hi maharṣīnāṃ vīryaṃ phalati tatkṣaṇam
udānapālād ityevaṃ taddeśe devyanugraham
garbhiṇyabhūt tato jāte dārake 'sminvyapadyata
tataḥ suratamañjaryapyatha padmavatī bhavet
śaśāṅkavatyapi tathā tataḥ syānmadirāvatī
iti ca stambhapṛṣṭhasthā kuṭṭanyevamacintayat
lajjitā trāsayantyenamakārṣaṃ bhairavaṃ vapuḥ
dūrasthatve ca yadyekaḥ śīlatyāgaṃ kariṣyati
avadacca candramauliḥ kauśāmbītyasti yā mahānagarī
deva dīyata ityuktvā sa ca mantrītyacintayat
iha rājñastu tanayā pāṭalītyasti kanyakā
surūpā strīti tacchrutvā vihasyāhaṃ tamabravam
bhagavatyupahāratve yata evāsi kalpitaḥ
bindumatyuditaṃ garbhaṃ muktaśokaṃ vipāṭaya
kaliṅgasenā viśrambhāt kathāṃ kurvatyuvāca sā
rākṣasyuditayā pūrvaṃ yuktyātyadbhutayā tayā
dṛṣṭā kanakapuryākhyā nagarī kṛtinā kila
tasmāt kanakapuryākhyāṃ nagarīṃ tāṃ gato 'bhavam
kanyā malayavatyākhyā svasā me 'sti kanīyasī
iti tenāsmi gatavān pathā sāpi purīdṛśī
kaścid dvīpāntaraṃ kaścid giriṃ kaścid digantaram
jātu karpūrikāṃ bhāryāṃ tataḥ kīdṛgbhaviṣyati
āstāṃ bahumlecchatayā digeṣā dakṣiṇāpatham
sa ca prāptābhiṣekaḥ san digjayāya yayau tataḥ
bhāryāṃ ca kāvyālaṃkārāṃ tādṛkkāryavidhāyinīm
iyacciraṃ ca jāto 'haṃ daivād īdṛṅniśācaraḥ
īdṛktu vācā niyamo grāhyaḥ saṃbandhināṃ tvayā
viveśojjayinīṃ tāṃ sa tādṛgyaugandharāyaṇaḥ
tathā vadhūtsāritahomalājāḥ surojjhitāḥ kausumavṛṣṭayo 'tra
rājan ṣaḍgranthalakṣāṇi mayā dagdhāni ṣaṭkathāḥ
cārairanviṣya tanmadhye labdhvā devagṛhāttataḥ
gatāsorasya bhūpasya śarīraṃ praviśāmyaham
asti kaścidupāyo me yena syurbahavaḥ sutāḥ
so 'haṃ gataḥ punarihādya manuṣyabhāvaṃ śāpena śailaduhiturbata kāṇabhūte
tvāṃ cennipātayetkaścittato me kā gatirbhavet
kṛcchrācca pratyabhijñātā mantribhirbhūbhṛtā tathā
ata eva sadā vastrairbhojanaiścopacaryase
ayaṃ mūrkho daridraśca viparīto 'sya cānujaḥ
tau ca prajāpatīnanyānsṛṣṭavantau prajāśca te
alabdhāntau tapobhirmāṃ toṣayāmāsatuśca tau
tanmadhyāt sa kanīyāṃśca rājñā saṃmānito 'bhavat
ardhacandraṃ śaraṃ matvā śiraśchedabhayāddrutam
niścityeti śiraśchettuṃ mayā śastramagṛhyata
mañjūṣāyāṃ sa ceṭībhirdattaṃ ca bahirargalam
avardhata tayoḥ prītirdaṃpatyorna tu yāminī
saṃbhogacihnaṃ pāṭalyā rakṣibhirdṛṣṭam ekadā
avaśyaṃ hanta nando 'yaṃ saptabhirdivasairmayā
avādīnnāparo yogyaḥ subandhurdhuri tiṣṭhatu
tayorekasya putro 'yamindradatto 'parasya ca
idaṃ bhājanameṣā ca yaṣṭirete ca pāduke
tadenaṃ nayataṃ bhrātā yuvayoreṣa kā kṣatiḥ
manmātuśca tadā pāpairgotrajaiḥ sakalaṃ hṛtam
tanmālyavāniti bhaviṣyasi me gaṇas tvam ityādiśac ca sa vibhurgirijāpatirmām
bilvairhomaṃ vidadhataṃ tatra brāhmaṇamaikṣata
tataḥ kṣaṇāt sā mañjūṣā prāpitā bahubhirjanaiḥ
tasya ca dvau sutau sādhorjāyete sma janapriyau
smṛtvā vararucirjātiṃ suptotthita ivāvadat
sā rājñī rakṣibhirlabdhā puṃsā strīrūpiṇā saha
nṛtyatyeṣa piturmittraṃ tava nando naṭaḥ suta
niragacchattataḥ sṛṣṭā sargāya prakṛtirmayā
ekadā sā madhau prāpte kṣāmā pāṇḍurmanoramā
alabdhāntau tapobhirmāṃ toṣayāmāsatuśca tau
tatraikaḥ pāṇinirnāma jaḍabuddhitaro 'bhavat
asti māmīkṣituṃ pūrvaṃ brahmā nārāyaṇastathā
sthānaṃ rājagṛhaṃ nāma jagmurvidyārjanecchayā
ityuktvā kṛtasaṃdhā sā tena kṣiptā vidhervaśāt
dadarśa ca samīpe 'sya piśācānāṃ śatairvṛtam
gurubhiryadi budhyeta tatkadācicchivaṃ bhavet
taṃ badaryāśramoddeśaṃ śāntaṃ vararuciryayau
tapaḥsthitau ca tatrāvāṃ sa svapne prabhurādiśat
vivāhe niścite gatvā vyāḍirānayati sma tām
sevyamāno 'pi hi snehairīdṛgeva kimapyasau
kaṃcit kālaṃ vratastho 'ham ity uktvā bhartrapekṣiṇī
rūpadarpopaśāntyai yā lakṣmyā dhātreva nirmitā
rājan ṣaḍgranthalakṣāṇi mayā dagdhāni ṣaṭkathāḥ
mittraṃ balair vyāptadiśaṃ prāvṛṭkālam ivāmbudaiḥ
ṣaṇmāsamadhye yadi me na sa dāsyati darśanam
lagnaṃ pṛṣṭo 'bravīddhyātvā ṣaṇmāsānte vyavasthitam
gateṣu cātra māseṣu ṣaṇmātreṣv asya bhūpateḥ
ṣaḍbāhuśālipramukhān sthāpayitvā taṭe sakhīn
bhakṣitais tarhi ṣaṇmāsān paritṛptā bhaviṣyasi
svaguṇāviṣkriyā doṣo nātra bhūtārthaśaṃsinaḥ
iha śiṣṭānuśiṣṭānāṃ śiṣṭānām api sarvathā
sargabandhasamā eva naite vaiśeṣikā guṇāḥ
nāyakenaiva vācyānyā nāyakenetareṇa vā
syād vapuḥ sundaram api śvitreṇaikena durbhagam
apabhraṃśaś ca miśraṃ cety āhur āryāś caturvidham
śravyam eveti saiṣāpi dvayī gatir udāhṛtā
nāyakenaiva vācyānyā nāyakenetareṇa vā
kāvyaṃ kalpottarasthāyi jāyate sadalaṃkṛti
vipralambhair vivāhaiś ca kumārodayavarṇanaiḥ
tad alpam api nopekṣyaṃ kāvye duṣṭaṃ kathaṃcana
bhedaś ca dṛṣṭo lambhādir ucchvāso vāstu kiṃ tataḥ
miśrāṇi nāṭakādīni teṣām anyatra vistaraḥ
yadi śabdāhvayaṃ jyotir āsaṃsāraṃ na dīpyate
kiṃ padmam antarbhrāntāli kiṃ te lolekṣaṇaṃ mukham
mṛgekṣaṇāṅkaṃ te vaktram mṛgeṇaivāṅkitaḥ śaśī
nedṛśaṃ bahu manyate mārgayor ubhayor api
kvāpi nītāḥ kuto 'py āsann ānītā daivatarddhayaḥ
ādirājayaśobimbam ādarśaṃ prāpya vāṅmayam
tad etad vāṅmayaṃ bhūyaḥ saṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtaṃ tathā
asty eva kvacid udvegaḥ prayoge vāgvidāṃ yathā
śatapattraṃ śaraccandras tvadānanam iti trayam
tajjayān nāyakotkarṣavarṇanaṃ ca dhinoti naḥ
tatkāraṇam upanyasya dāruṇaṃ jaladāgamam
asti ced astu tatkārīty asāv aniyamopamā
kāścinmārgavibhāgārtham uktāḥ prāg apyalaṃkriyāḥ
āśīr namaskriyā vastunirdeśo vāpi tanmukham
arthināṃ kṛpaṇā dṛṣṭis tvanmukhe patitā sakṛt
sāgaraḥ sūktiratnānāṃ setubandhādi yanmayam
tatpadavyām padaṃ dhatte tasya kakṣāṃ vigāhate
itīdaṃ nādṛtaṃ gauḍair anuprāsas tu tatpriyaḥ
vastu kiṃcid upanyasya nyasanāt tatsadharmaṇaḥ
tatsamān darśayitveha śliṣṭākṣepas tathāvidhaḥ
iti mārgadvayaṃ bhinnaṃ tatsvarūpanirūpaṇāt

koṭīsahasram ugrāṇāṃ harīṇāṃ samakarṣata
krodho harṣaśca darpaśca hrīstambho mānyamānitā
sattre samṛddhe 'tirathasya rājño vedītalād utpatitā sutā yā
ūrmītaraṃgair jāhnavyāḥ samānītām upahvaram
tvayā ca kāvyam ityuktaṃ tasmāt kāvyaṃ bhaviṣyati
pāṇḍavā eta ityuktvā munayo 'ntarhitās tataḥ
tato jñāsyasi māṃ saute prajñācakṣuṣam ityuta
trīṇyugravīryāṇi samāgatāni tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
tad indraḥ surabhīvākyaṃ niśamya bhṛśavismitaḥ
vedīvilagnamadhyeva bibhratī rūpam uttamam
vividhasya ca dharmasya hyāśramāṇāṃ ca lakṣaṇam
ācakhyuḥ kavayaḥ kecit sampratyācakṣate pare
bahūni samparikramya tīrthānyāyatanāni ca
na hīdṛśaṃ saṃvananaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate
tām ahaṃ varṇayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ bho munīśvarāḥ
sa taṃ kāmam avācyaṃ vai dāśakanyāṃ pratīdṛśam
asya tu tvaṃ phalaṃ mūḍha prāpsyasīdṛśam eva hi
koṭīśatasahasraṃ ca teṣu lokeṣu modate
koṭīśatasahasreṇa laṅkām abhyapatat tadā
koṭīśatavṛtau cāpi gajo gavaya eva ca
aham apyūrdhvaretā vai nivṛtto dārakarmaṇi
dvyūnā viṃśatir āhatākṣauhiṇīnāṃ tasmin saṃgrāme vigrahe kṣatriyāṇām
ityūcur bahavastatra vitaṇḍānāḥ parasparam
ityūcuśca tadā devāḥ prītāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ
phalantyṛtuṣu vṛkṣāśca puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca
dhanūṃṣi cāgryāṇi śarāśca mukhyāḥ śaktyṛṣṭayaḥ kāñcanabhūṣitāśca
iyaṃ yā rājasūyasya samrāḍarhasya sukratoḥ
bhūr bhāti bharataśreṣṭha sragdāmair iva citritā
sragdhūpagandhānyanulepanāni snānāni mālyāni ca mānavo yaḥ
tulādhāro vaṇigdharmā vārāṇasyāṃ mahāyaśāḥ
bhayaṃ tathā ripuṣu samādadhad bhṛśaṃ vaṇiggaṇānāṃ kṣubhito yathārṇavaḥ
sa tvaṃ samrāḍguṇair yuktaḥ sadā bharatasattama
tena rājāpi san kṛtsnaṃ samrāḍguṇam abhīpsati
tasya samrāḍguṇārhasya bhavataḥ kurunandana
nārāyaṇo mahad bhūtaṃ viśvasṛgghavyakavyabhuk
śarīrasaṃghāṭavahā asṛgjalā rathoḍupā kuñjaraśailasaṃkaṭā
vitunnāṅgaṃ śaraśatair nyastāyudham asṛkkṣaram
tair āhatau sarvamanuṣyamukhyāv asṛkkṣarantau dhanadendrakalpau
āturasya bhiṣaṅmitraṃ dānaṃ mitraṃ mariṣyataḥ
kurvan sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ pakṣirāṇna vyakampata
tuṣṭāva rājānam anantakīrtim ṛtviksadasyāṃśca tathaiva cāgnim
snātām ahatasaṃvītāṃ gandhaliptāṃ sragujjvalām
dākṣiṇātyaḥ saṃnahanaṃ sraguṣṇīṣe ca māgadhaḥ
sviṣṭakṛd bhiṣagāvartaḥ kapilastvaṃ ca vāmanaḥ
ekānarthān pṛthagarthān ekaduḥkhān pṛthaksukhān
pṛthagdharmāḥ pṛthakśaucāsteṣāṃ tu brāhmaṇo varaḥ
idaṃ vṛthaiva skannaṃ me retaḥ sa sumahān vadhaḥ
utthitaḥ prāgghradād vīraḥ pragṛhya mahatīṃ gadām
samyagghi dharmaṃ carato nṛpasya dravyāṇi cāpyāharato yathāvat
samyagghuta iva sviṣṭaḥ praśānto 'gnir ivādhvare
pratigrahāyābhinanarda śalyaḥ samyagghutām agnir ivājyadhārām
nātidūrācca rājānam avātiṣṭhad avāṅmukhī
svargapāraṃ titīrṣan sa śataśṛṅgād udaṅmukhaḥ
vāsavāḥ pañca rājānaḥ pṛthagvaṃśāśca śāśvatāḥ
evaṃ nāmābhinirvṛttaṃ tasya deśasya vai dvijāḥ
mātuśca parameṣvāsastau ca nāmāsya cakratuḥ
tena gandhavatītyeva nāmāsyāḥ prathitaṃ bhuvi
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ jaratkāror nāmaitat prathitaṃ bhuvi
sāmaiva kurubhiḥ sārdham icchanti kurupuṃgavāḥ
sāmaivāsmin prayuyuje na mumoha na vivyathe
kiṃviśiṣṭāḥ kasya dhāmopayānti tad vai brūhi kṣetravit tvaṃ mato me
etasminnantare jātaṃ vāsuker mukhaniḥsravāt
paṭṭiśāś ca bhuśuṇḍyaś ca prāpatannaniśaṃ mayi
anāryāṃ śayane bibhrad ujhan bibhracca yo dvijām
ciraṃ saṃcintayann arthāṃściraṃ jāgracciraṃ svapan
yadāśrauṣaṃ vaiśravaṇena sārdhaṃ samāgataṃ bhīmam anyāṃśca pārthān
annavān dakṣiṇāvāṃśca sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ
śūrān pāñcālān pāṇḍaveyāṃśca yuktāṃs tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
sa sarvān pārthivāñ jitvā sarvāṃśca mahato gaṇān
dṛśyanneva hi lokān sa bhasmarāśīkariṣyati
etasminneva kāle tu dyumatseno mahāvane
garhayanneva rāmastu tvaritas taṃ samāsadat
pāñcālānāṃ dadaddharṣaṃ kuruvṛddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ
kimarthaṃ cādhvare brahmannijyante tridivaukasaḥ
ādadhajjīvalokasya duḥkham uttamam uttamaḥ
trīn agnīn iva kauravyāñjanayāmāsa vīryavān
lokāllokam imaṃ prāptau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī
prāgrasallokarakṣārthaṃ tato jyeṣṭhā samutthitā
asmiṃlloke yaśaḥ prāpya tataḥ kālavaśaṃ gatāḥ
kālo vikurute bhāvān sarvāṃlloke śubhāśubhān
na te kratuśatair lokāḥ prāpyante divi mānada tapobhir vividhair vāpi yāṃllokān putriṇo gatāḥ
yasmiṃstacchrūyate satyaṃ jyotir brahma sanātanam
śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam
yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati
kathaṃ rājā prajā rakṣannādhibandhena yujyate
na pāṇḍavāñśreṣṭhatamān nihanti tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
lubdhā durvṛttabhūyiṣṭhā na tāñśocitum arhasi
te 'pyadhītyākhilān vedāñśāstrāṇi vividhāni ca
ajayañchātravānmukhyāṃstathā tvam api jeṣyasi
paśyāmi lokān amalāñchucīn brāhmaṇayāyinaḥ
tat kīrtyamānaṃ bhagavañchrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ
śamī śamayate rogāñchamī sarvārthasādhanā
iha te vai carūn prāśnannṛṣayaś ca viśāṃ pate
gavādhyakṣastu saṃtrasto ratham āsthāya satvaraḥ
gavārthe brāhmaṇasyārthe sadyaḥ prāṇān parityajet
tato bahudhanaṃ ramyaṃ gavāśvadhanadhānyavat
gavāśvaṃ bahudhenūkam aparyantam ajāvikam
nipānānīva go'bhyāśe kṣetre kulyeva bhārata
manasā goṣu na druhyed govṛttir go'nukampakaḥ
īśā rakṣaḥsu sādhvyasmi rājñī sālakaṭaṅkaṭī
gavendraṃ brāhmaṇendrāya bhūriśṛṅgam alaṃkṛtam
gavādibhyas tathāśvebhyo devatvam api dṛśyate
gavāḍhyaḥ śākadīkṣāyāṃ svargagāmī tṛṇāśanaḥ
devo yaḥ saṃsthitas tasminn abbindur iva puṣkare
manuṣyadurgam abdurgaṃ vanadurgaṃ ca tāni ṣaṭ
abjānāṃ pittabhedaśca sarveṣām iti naḥ śrutam
ammayaṃ sarvam evedam āpo mūrtiḥ śarīriṇām
ahaśca rātriśca ubhe ca saṃdhye dharmaśca jānāti narasya vṛttam
dharo dhruvaśca somaśca ahaścaivānilo 'nalaḥ
tvam agne sarvabhūtānām antaścarasi nityadā
avarohaṇaṃ punaścaiva pāṇḍūnāṃ gandhamādanāt
yo 'ham evaṃ kṛto mātastvayā lobhaparītayā
śaṃtanor veśmani punasteṣāṃ cārohaṇaṃ divi
dhanurabhyāśam āgamya tolayāmāsa tad dhanuḥ
dhanurbāṇadharaṃ bālā lobhayāmāsa gautamam
śīle sthitir daṇḍanidhānam ārjavaṃ tatastataścoparamaḥ kriyābhyaḥ
ataśca pāpān mucye'ham eṣa me prārthito varaḥ
śatānyupari caivāṣṭau tathā bhūyaśca saptatiḥ
śāpenaiva ca karṇasya tataścakraṃ mahīgatam
droṇaparva tataścitraṃ bahuvṛttāntam ucyate
yataśchidraṃ tataścāpi nayante dhīdhanā balam
dṛṣṭvā rathagataṃ pārthaṃ khaḍgapāṇiṃ dhanurdharam
sa rājā śaṃtanur dhīmān khyātaḥ pṛthvyāṃ dhanurdharaḥ
dhanurdharā māṃsahetor mṛgāṇāṃ kṣayaṃ cakrur nityam evopagamya
dhanurgrāhaś cārjunaḥ savyasācī dhanuś ca tad gāṇḍivaṃ lokasāram
ati sarvān dhanurgrāhān sūtaputrasya lāghavam
havirgandhaṃ deśikaṃ yajñabhūmer dhūmāpāṅgaṃ pratigṛhya pratītaḥ
tasya śabdena ghoreṇa dhanurghoṣeṇa cābhibho
kauśyāṃ bṛsyāṃ samāsīnaṃ cakṣurhīnaṃ nṛpaṃ tadā
tena śabdena vitrastā dhanurhastā mahārathāḥ
maraṇaṃ śobhanaṃ tasya iti vidvajjanā viduḥ
vegaṃ cakre mahāvego dhanurjyām avamṛjya ca
dhanurjyātalaśabdaśca saṃspṛśan gaganaṃ mahat
indriyāṇāṃ samastānāṃ citrā iva manaḥkriyāḥ
nārhasi vidvanmām uparoddhum iti
na snātakavratā viprā bahirmālyānulepanāḥ
duryodhano bhayād vidvanna dadyāt padam antataḥ
teṣāṃ parikramān kathayantastato 'nyān naitad vidvannaiva kṛtaṃ ca karma
cakṣurnāśe tanor nāśaḥ putranāśe kulakṣayaḥ
apūjayanmahābhāgaṃ tathā vidvattayaiva tu
tat te tapaḥ pravakṣyāmi vidvaṃstad api me śṛṇu
ādatte raśmibhiḥ sūryo divi vidvaṃstatastataḥ
tejomanyuśca vidvaṃstvaṃ jāto raudro mahāmate
cakṣurviṣau mahāvīryau nityakruddhau tarasvinau
yodhāḥ samṛddhāstad vidvannācakṣīthā yathātatham
ātmano darśanaṃ vidvannāhantāsmīti mā krudhaḥ
dvirūnaṃ daśarātraṃ vai nāgasyāgamanaṃ prati
ataūrdhvam araṇyaṃ ca sevitavyaṃ narādhipa
manaḥṣaṣṭhāni sarvāṇi buddhyabhāve kuto guṇāḥ
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ yat tat sadasadātmakam
asacca saccaiva ca yad viśvaṃ sadasataḥ param
balabandhur nirāmardaḥ ketuśṛṅgo bṛhadbalaḥ
asacca saccaiva ca yad viśvaṃ sadasataḥ param
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca trividhaṃ kālasaṃjñitam
asacca saccaiva ca yad viśvaṃ sadasataḥ param
trayastriṃśacca devānāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ saṃkṣepalakṣaṇā
tadā bhūr abhavacchannā jalormibhir anekaśaḥ
vistīrṇaṃ caiva naḥ sainyaṃ hanyācchidreṣu vai paraḥ
aviṣaṇṇaśca tau prādācchittvā droṇasya vetanam
putram aṅgeśvaraṃ snehācchannā prītir avardhata
samyak saddharmamūlā hi vyasane śāntir uttamā
nārāyaṇaṃ suraguruṃ jagadekanāthaṃ bhaktapriyaṃ sakalalokanamaskṛtaṃ ca
nagarāddhāstinapurād balasaṃkhyānam eva ca
te tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā mantrayitvā ca yaddhitam
vistīryaitan mahajjñānam ṛṣiḥ saṃkṣepam abravīt
idaṃ tu triṣu lokeṣu mahajjñānaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
loke sajjanaṣaṭpadair aharahaḥ pepīyamānaṃ mudā
tasmāllambāmahe garte naṣṭasaṃjñā hyanāthavat
tasmāllokavināśāya hyavatiṣṭhe na saṃśayaḥ
yatrāsya yuddhaṃ sumahat tair āsīllomaharṣaṇam
garutmanmanyase ''tmānaṃ balavantaṃ sudurbalam
apratiṣṭhe tamasyetaj jaganmajjed anindite
bhagavannaralokasthaṃ naṣṭaṃ brahma sanātanam
mayi kruddhe jaganna syānmayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
idaṃ dvaipāyanaḥ pūrvaṃ putram adhyāpayacchukam
tacchrutvā sarvam ākhyātaṃ loke jñāsyanti mānavāḥ
triṃśacchatasahasraṃ ca devaloke pratiṣṭhitam
āditya iva duṣprekṣyaḥ samareṣvapi cābhavat
nāpaśyāma tatastvetat sainyaṃ vai tamasāvṛtam
bhaviṣyatparva cāpyuktaṃ khileṣvevādbhutaṃ mahat
atha teṣūpaviṣṭeṣu sarveṣveva tapasviṣu
ātmeva veditavyeṣu priyeṣviva ca jīvitam
śrutvā tvidam upākhyānaṃ śrāvyam anyan na rocate
paścāt tvimāṃ pitā prādād bhṛgave 'nṛtakāriṇe
kiṃ tviyaṃ vidhinā pūrvaṃ mantravan na vṛtā tvayā
te tvasmaddhitakāmārthaṃ pālanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ
tataḥ pañcaśate kāle kadrūputrā viniḥsṛtāḥ
dvau putrau vinatā vavre kadrūputrādhikau bale
ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ kadrūputrān anusmaran
varjayellavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ tathā jambūphalāni ca
jantūpākhyānam atraiva yatra putreṇa somakaḥ
atha teṣūpaviṣṭeṣu sarveṣveva tapasviṣu
upaviṣṭeṣūpaviṣṭaḥ śaunako 'thābravīd idam
kravyādair bhakṣyamāṇān vai gomāyubaḍavāyasaiḥ
tasyāpi gomāyubaḍābhigupto babhūva ketur jvalanārkatulyaḥ
sudarśano nāma mahāñ jambūvṛkṣaḥ sanātanaḥ
varapradānaṃ bhartrā ca kadrūvinatayostathā
manvādi bhārataṃ kecid āstīkādi tathāpare
śalyo 'rdhadivasaṃ tvāsīd gadāyuddham ataḥ param
yadāśrauṣaṃ vāhaneṣvāśvasatsu rathopasthe tiṣṭhatā gāṇḍivena
kasya tvīdṛśakaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvāpi svalpacetasaḥ
tair vimukto ratho reje vāyvīrita ivāmbudaḥ
aśvaskandheṣu cakreṣu yugeṣvīṣāsu caiva ha
bāhūrucaraṇān anyān viśikhonmathitān pṛthak
bāhūrumūladantānāṃ darśanaṃ vai varāṅganāḥ
athāsya bāhūruśirolalāṭaṃ grīvāṃ rathāṅgāni parāvamardī
sarveṣvṛtuṣu rājendra sarvaṃ sasyaṃ bhaviṣyati
āvikṣitaḥ pārthivo vai maruttaḥ svṛddhyā martyo yo 'jayad devarājam
vyāharatsvṛṣiputreṣu mā sma kiṃcid vaco vadīḥ
parigṛhyāgrato rājañjaghnatuḥ śataśaḥ parān
gandharvāñśataśo rājañjaghāna niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
bho bho rājañjanakānāṃ variṣṭha sabhājyas tvaṃ tvayi sarvaṃ samṛddham
yadā sa pūrustava rūpeṇa rājañjarāṃ gṛhītvā pracacāra bhūmau
na prāṇināṃ te spṛhayanti rājañśivaśca kālaḥ sa babhūva teṣām
vane nivasato rājañśiṣyante sma kadācana
dānaṃ ca satyaṃ ca tapaś ca rājañśraddhā ca śāntiś ca dhṛtiḥ kṣamā ca
rājañśīlanidhiḥ sphīto damayantyā surakṣitaḥ
bhraṣṭaiśvaryā svadoṣeṇa patasi tvaṃ śucismite
svatejasā tasya nagottamasya mahauṣadhīnāṃ ca tathā prabhāvāt
mamātmajaṃ satyavatas tathaurasaṃ bhaved ubhābhyām iha yat kulodvaham
suhotraṃ rantidevaṃ ca kakṣīvantaṃ tathauśijam
tasmin kṣaṇe kṛtasnānaṃ mahadambarasaṃvṛtam
kauravyavadhyata camūḥ pāṇḍuputrair mahārathaiḥ
manvādi bhārataṃ kecid āstīkādi tathāpare
putrā vivasvataḥ sarve mahyas teṣāṃ tathāvaraḥ
manye śreṣṭhatamaṃ tvādya rahasyajñānavedanāt
śrutvāhaṃ tā vicitrārthā mahābhāratasaṃśritāḥ
sa saṃnyasya mahaccāpam abhivādya pitāmaham
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni vedādhyātmaṃ tathaiva ca
ākhyāsyanti tathaivānye itihāsam imaṃ bhuvi
yathaitāni variṣṭhāni tathā bhāratam ucyate
diṣṭyedam āgatam iti matvā sa prājñasattamaḥ
kṛtaṃ mayedaṃ bhagavan kāvyaṃ paramapūjitam
smṛtāstisrastu vāhinyaḥ pṛtaneti vicakṣaṇaiḥ
ahaṃ draṣṭā brahmaloke sadeti tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
na sa tāṃ pratijagrāha na sanāmnīti cintayan
sa tathoktastathetyuktvā lubdho gātrāṇyatāpayat
bhīmam ārtasvaraṃ kṛtvā hāheti paricukruśuḥ
gagane racitā mālā kāñcanīva vyarājata
tena tenaiva sampannā kāśmīrīva turaṃgamā
āsurīva yathā senā nigṛhīte purā balau
bharatānāṃ mahajjanma mahābhāratam ityuta
tasyādbhutaṃ karma kṛtvā mahanmṛdbhāram ādade
mahaughabalam aśvānām uttamaṃ javatāṃ varam
rājasūye śriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavasya mahaujasaḥ
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yakṣāṇāṃ ca mahaujasām
utsṛjya tu śubhaṃ dehaṃ jagāmendrasya bhāryatām
sa rāhuśchādayatyetau yathākālaṃ mahattayā
etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ mahattvaṃ prati rājasu
mahattvena ca saṃyukto vaiṣṇavena naro bhuvi
mahattvāt tasya daṇḍasya nītir vispaṣṭalakṣaṇā
etayopamayā dhīraḥ saṃnameta balīyase
śrutavān asi vai rājño mahotsāhān mahābalān
ekaṃ śatasahasraṃ tu mayoktaṃ vai nibodhata
yadāśrauṣaṃ śrāntahaye dhanaṃjaye muktvā hayān pāyayitvopavṛttān
tathoparicarādyanye viprāḥ samyag adhīyate
svastho 'smi balavān asmi didṛkṣuḥ pitarāvubhau
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryamapūrvaṃ vidhivistaram
yasyeyaṃ phalanirvṛttir īdṛśyāsāditā mayā
pārāśaryavacaḥsarojam amalaṃ gītārthagandhotkaṭaṃ nānākhyānakakesaraṃ harikathāsambodhanābodhitam
dharmānilendrāṃs tābhiḥ sājuhāva sutavāñchayā
niṣprabhe 'smin nirāloke sarvatas tamasāvṛte
viśvedevās tathādityā vasavo 'thāśvināvapi
vaśyatāṃ ca gato 'sau naḥ kariṣyati yathepsitam
gṛhāṇa yauvanaṃ mattaścara kāmān yathepsitān
saṃpranṛttam ivākāśaṃ dhārormibhir anekaśaḥ
mahodadhiḥ satimitimiṃgilastathā mahormimān bahumakaro jhaṣālayaḥ
vivāhānāṃ hi rambhoru gāndharvaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate
priyārthaṃ maharṣeś cāpi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
maharṣeḥ pūjitasyeha sarvaloke mahātmanaḥ
pitāmahādyaṃ pravadanti ṣaṣṭhaṃ maharṣim akṣayyavibhūtiyuktam
evaṃ vai saṃgrahādhyāyaḥ pūrvam eva maharṣiṇā
draupadyarthaṃ bhīmasenena saṃkhye tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
amṛtārthe ca lakṣmyarthe mahāntaṃ vairam āśritāḥ
brahmā suraguruḥ sthāṇur manuḥ kaḥ parameṣṭhyatha
sāvitryauddālakīyaṃ ca vainyopākhyānam eva ca
pṛthivyāpaś ca tejaś ca khaṃ vāyuś ca parāyaṇam
sakhibhāryāṃ guror bhāryāṃ rājabhāryāṃ tathaiva ca
śacīva devendram athāgnidevaṃ svāheva lakṣmīśca yathāprameyam
lakṣmīścaiṣāṃ pūrvam evopadiṣṭā bhāryā yaiṣā draupadī divyarūpā
śvacaryām atimānaṃ ca sakhidāreṣu viplavam
dṛṣṭavatyeva kaunteya kandarpeṇāsmi mūrchitā
rākṣasyeṣā hi vākyena dharmaṃ vadati sādhu vai
kiṃnāmnī bhaginīyaṃ te brūhi satyaṃ bhujaṃgama
yugāntakāle saṃkruddhaḥ pinākīva mahābalaḥ
vanavāsarataṃ nityaṃ vanavāsīti lakṣayet
aham eva gatisteṣāṃ nirāśīḥkarmakāriṇām
pāpā ca pañcaputrā sā pṛthāyāḥ sakhimāninī
mṛtyur asya mahābāho raṇe devakinandanaḥ
haraṇaṃ gṛhya samprāpte kṛṣṇe devakinandane
gāndhāriputrasya vaco niśamya dharmād asmāt kuravo māpayāta
gāndhāriputrāḥ śocantaḥ sarve te saha bāndhavaiḥ
śūrasya na sakhā klībaḥ sakhipūrvaṃ kim iṣyate
amarāvatisaṃkāśaṃ puraṃ kāmagamaṃ tu tat
hariścandro maruttaśca jahnur jāhnavisevitā
sā lateva mahāśālaṃ phullaṃ gomatitīrajam
tvāṃ saṃrakṣeta pavanaḥ sakhitvena na saṃśayaḥ
yathā nārāyaṇe lakṣmīstathā tvaṃ bhava bhartṛṣu
abhivartati lakṣmīstaṃ prācīm iva divākaraḥ
yeṣām abhimukhī lakṣmīsteṣāṃ kṛṣṇa tvam agrataḥ
vicitāni ca sarvāṇi udyānāni nadīstathā
sa māṃ sairandhriveṣeṇa vasantīṃ rājaveśmani
tasmād droṇaḥ parājaiṣīn māṃ vai sa sakhivigrahe
yad vai loke vaidikaṃ karma sādhu āśīryuktaṃ taddhi tasyopabhojyam
sa rājā cakravartyāsīt sārvabhaumaḥ pratāpavān
rāmākhyānaṃ tataḥ parva sāvitryākhyānam eva ca
dārayann iva padbhyāṃ sa jagatīṃ jagatīśvaraḥ
te vai ratnabhujaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ratnārhaṃ pṛthivīśvarāḥ
tvaṃ brāhmaṇo yadi vā kṣatriyo 'si samudranemīśvararūpavān asi
digambarāmbhasāṃ karṇa samudrasthā hi durjayāḥ
kāṃdigbhūtaṃ chinnagātraṃ visaṃjñaṃ duryodhano drakṣyati sarvasainyam
kāṃdigbhūtāḥ śrāntapatrā hatāstrā hatacetasaḥ
tatkṣetraṃ yacca yādṛkca yadvikāri yataśca yat
eṣa te paścimo mārgo digdvāreṇa prakīrtitaḥ
te tu lokāḥ sahasrākṣa śṛṇu yādṛgguṇānvitāḥ
tayor nṛvarayo rājan dṛśya tādṛkparākramam
tādṛgrūpam idaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ mama suhṛdbruvaiḥ
yādṛgrūpā hi te chāyā prasannaśca janārdanaḥ
mahāmūrdhā mahāmātro mahānetro digālayaḥ
yaṃ dṛgātmānam ātmasthaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhir guṇaiḥ
yatra brahmādayo devā diśaś ca sadigīśvarāḥ
bhaikṣacaryā na vihitā na ca viṭśūdrajīvikā
tathā viṭśūdrasaṃghānāṃ mahān vyatikaro 'bhavat
rājñāṃ tu rākṣaso 'pyukto viṭśūdreṣvāsuraḥ smṛtaḥ
ṣaṇmārgaṇānām ayutāni vīra kṣurāś ca bhallāś ca tathāyutākhyāḥ
agnirāpas tathākāśaṃ pṛthivī vāyur eva ca
tato hāhākṛte sainye dṛṣṭvā bhīmaṃ nṛpābruvan
evaṃ siddhābruvan vāco bhaviṣyati ca tat tathā
tena tad vanam ādīptam iti me tāpasābruvan
tair iyaṃ puruṣavyāghrair vidyābāhubalānvitaiḥ
uttare kosalābhāge puṇye rājanmahātmanaḥ
dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ sahāmātyo vyathito vimanābhavat
taistaiśca vividhair bhāvaistatra tatra vasuṃdharā
surair brahmarṣibhiścaiva śrutvā yad abhipūjitam
apṛcchat sa tapovṛddhiṃ sadbhiścaivābhinanditaḥ
vistaraiśca samāsaiśca dhāryate yad dvijātibhiḥ
vidvāṃścaivaṃ matimān āryabuddhir mamābhavat karmalokyaṃ ca sarvam
priyaścaiṣām ātmasamaśca kṛṣṇo vidvāṃścaiṣāṃ karmaṇi nityayuktaḥ
matinārastato rājā vidvāṃścarceputo 'bhavat
na cainaṃ dadṛśuśchannā rajasāmṛtarakṣiṇaḥ
sasaṃjñaścāpi saṃvṛttaśchittvā bandhanam āśu naḥ
tathā varaiśchandyamāne rājñā pārikṣitena ha
tato bhagavatā tasya śiraśchinnam alaṃkṛtam
sārathiṃ cābravīt kruddho yāhi yatraiṣa pārthivaḥ
tasmin nipatite vīre gadānunne mahāsure
nāsti yuddhe kṛtī kaścinna vidvānna parākramī
priyāpriye sukhaduḥkhe ca rājann evaṃ vidvānnaiva yuddhaṃ kuruṣva
kanyātvaṃ ca dadau prītaḥ punar vidvāṃstapodhanaḥ
kāśyapo 'bhyāgamad vidvāṃstaṃ rājānaṃ cikitsitum
vidvāṃstāṃ vāsavīṃ kanyāṃ kāryavān munipuṃgavaḥ
evam uktāha dhātrīṃ tāṃ śarmiṣṭhāvṛjinaṃ kṛtam
ityuktvā garuḍaṃ sarṣiḥ māṅgalyam akarot tadā
udairayad brāhmam astraṃ śaraiḥ sampūrayan diśaḥ
taṃ samutthāpayāmāsa nṛpatiṃ kāmamohitam
nābhijajñe sa nṛpatir duhitrarthe samāgatam
prāhur viṣayagoptāraṃ tasmai goptrātmane namaḥ
ṣaḍanarthā mahārāja kaccit te pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtāḥ
ṣaḍaratni dhanuścāsya dṛśyate 'pratimaṃ mahat
ṣaḍaṅgaścākhilo veda imaṃ garbhastham eva hi
trimukhaṃ ṣaḍbhujaṃ dīptam arkajvalanamūrdhajam
yeṣāṃ ṣaḍbhāgahartā tvam ubhayoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ
dviṭchidradarśī nṛpatir nityam eva praśasyate
ete hy ā maraṇāt pañca ṣaḍguṇā jñānasiddhaye
ṣaḍindriyāṇi viṣayaṃ samāgacchanti vai yadā
gāṇḍīvasya ca nirghoṣaṃ prāvṛḍjaladanisvanam
sa jāyamāno vigṛhītagātraḥ ṣaḍjñānaniṣṭhāyatano manuṣyaḥ
so 'paśyat saritaṃ pūrṇāṃ prāvṛṭkāle navāmbhasā
ṣaṭkṛtvas tat tu nikṣiptam agne retaḥ kurūttama
anīkānāṃ vibhāgena panthānaḥ ṣaṭkṛtābhavan
kāryārthinastu ṣaṇmāsaṃ viharadhvaṃ yathāsukham
samānapadye ṣaṇmāsān sthito vidyāṃ labhed imām
ṣaḍrasaṃ cāmṛtarasaṃ rasāyanam anuttamam
oṣadhyaḥ ṣaḍrasā medhyās tadannaṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi
kṣānta uṣyātra ṣaḍrātraṃ prāpnoti sugatiṃ naraḥ
ṣaṭsūryevābabhau pṛthvī pāṇḍavaiḥ satyavikramaiḥ
ṣaḍvaktraḥ kuñjaro rājan sa tu saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ
ṣaḍvarṣa eva bālaḥ sa kaṇvāśramapadaṃ prati
narāśvanāgāsuharaṃ tryaratniṃ ṣaḍvājam añjogatim ugravegam
kailāsaḥ parvato rājan ṣaḍyojanaśatānyuta
ṣaḍādhāne dakṣiṇām āhur eke ṣaḍ eveme ṛtavaḥ kālacakram
pṛthubhiḥ pañcabhī raṅgaiḥ samāvṛttāṃ ṣaḍāyatām
ṣaḍāyatāṃ supārśvoruṃ tripṛthuṃ pañcasaṃvṛtām
mumoca ṣaṭśatān bāṇān gṛhītvaikam iva drutam
ṣaṭśatāni ca pūrṇāni viṣkambho jambuparvataḥ
agnīn sājanayat puṇyān ṣaḍekāṃ cāpi putrikām
ṣaṇmāsān ekacakrāyāṃ varṣaṃ pāñcālake gṛhe
kṣudhārtaścāham agatir nirāśaḥ śvamāṃse cāsmin ṣaḍrasān sādhu manye
karṇaṃ duryodhanaṃ caiva droṇaputraṃ ca ṣaḍrathān
api caikarūpye sati deśabhedena kāmaṃ deśā eva bhinnā na tu śabdaḥ
atha gaur ity atra kaḥ śabdo gakāraukāravisarjanīyā iti bhagavān upavarṣaḥ
anyasyāpi karmaṇo 'nantaraṃ dharmajijñāsā yuktā prāg api ca vedādhyayanāt
nādhyāhārādibhir eṣāṃ parikalpanīyo 'rthaḥ paribhāṣitavyo vā
anyasyāpi karmaṇo 'nantaraṃ dharmajijñāsā yuktā prāg api ca vedādhyayanāt
aparo dṛṣṭavirodho na caitad vidmo vayaṃ brāhmaṇā vā smo 'brāhmaṇā vety akriyārthatvād anarthakam
iha devatābhir apratyakṣābhir yajñāṅgaiś cācetanaiḥ saṃlāpe na kaścid yajñasyopakāraḥ
itthaṃ cācetanā api grāvāṇa āmantryante
bhavati tu sāmānyapratyayo 'dṛṣṭapūrvāyām api govyaktau
dūrabhūyastvād dhūmasyāgneś cādarśane gauṇaḥ śabdaḥ
na cādṛṣṭapūrve smṛtir bhavati
kathaṃ duṣṭāduṣṭāvagama iti cet prayatnenānvicchanto na ced doṣam upalabhemahi pramāṇābhāvād aduṣṭam iti manyemahi
evaṃ hi vedavākyāny evaibhir vyākhyāyante
api ca naiva vayam iha vedādhyayanāt pūrvaṃ dharmajijñāsāyāḥ pratiṣedhaṃ śiṣmaḥ
na cedaṃ snānam adṛṣṭārthaṃ vidhīyate
na ceha kiṃcid vṛttam upalabhyate
sa punaḥ kathaṃ jijñāsitavyaḥ ko dharmaḥ kathaṃlakṣaṇaḥ kāny asya sādhanāni kāni sādhanābhāsāni kiṃparaś ceti
kiṃ tu lakṣaṇayāsnānādiniyamasya paryavasānaṃ vedādhyayanasamakālam āhur vedam adhītya snāyād gurukulān mā samāvartiṣṭety adṛṣṭārthatāparihārāyaiva
bhavati hi kadācid etad yaj jñāto 'rthaḥ so 'jñāta ity ucyate
na ca jñātari vijñānād anyasmin asati jñāne cānitye aparedyur icchānupapannā pratyakṣāvagatatvād eva
kathaṃ punar idam avagamyate 'pauruṣeya eṣa saṃbandha iti puruṣasya saṃbandhur abhāvāt
tad idānīm ucyate 'pauruṣeyatvāt saṃbandhasya siddham iti
ucyate 'prākṛtasya bahoḥ karmasamūhasyopasthitatvād gauṇo mohaśabdo 'vadhāraṇāvakāśadānādibhir jñāpayatīti gauṇatā
ūrg vā udumbara iti hetutvaṃ cāprasiddham
syād etad evaṃ naiva śabdasyārthenāsti saṃbandhaḥ kuto 'sya pauruṣeyatāpauruṣeyatā veti
ucyate 'sadvṛttāntānvākhyānaṃ stutyarthena praśaṃsāyā gamyamānatvāt
vane 'pi te 'sati vanapratyayaḥ prāpnotīti
anumānaṃ jñātasaṃbandhasya ekadeśadarśanād ekadeśāntare 'saṃnikṛṣṭe 'rthe buddhiḥ
evam api prakṛtaṃ dūṣayitum aśaknuvantas te siddhāntāntaradūṣaṇaṃ nigrahasthānam āpadyate 'sādhakatvāt
na cāsiddhe 'bhāve vyāmoho na ca siddho 'bhāvaḥ
stutaś cāstutaś ca tāvān eva so 'rthaḥ
sataś caitad upalambhanaṃ nāsataḥ
nāsati vyāmohavijñāne vikalpo bhavati
satīndriyārthasaṃprayoge nāsatīty etāvad avadhāryate
anyasmin skandhaghane 'nyena skandhaghanena yaj jñānaṃ tat tatsantatijenānyenopalabhyate nātatsantatijena
katham arthajñānayor ākārabhedaṃ nopalabhāmahe
aviyuktaḥ śabdārthayor bhāvaḥ saṃbandhena notpannayoḥ paścāt saṃbandhaḥ
na ca arthavyapadeśam antareṇa buddheḥ rūpopalambhanam
upadeśa iti viśiṣṭasya śabdasyoccāraṇam
kim atraikaḥ śabdo 'vicchinnapāramparyo 'rthābhidhāyītare 'pabhraṃśā uta sarve 'nādayaḥ
adhyāyānadhyāyate gurumukhāt pratipattiḥ śiṣyopādhyāyatā ca sarvasminn evaṃjātīyake 'vighnārthe tulyam ādriyante
na gamyamāne 'rthe 'vivakṣitārthāni bhavitum arhanti
api ca nigamādibhir arthe kalpayamāne 'vyavasthitaḥ śabdārtho bhavet tatrāniścayaḥ syāt
tadā cāvartamānaṃ stautuṃ vartamānam ity upadiśati
api cāvigītaḥ suhṛdupadeśaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ katham ivāśaṅketonmattabālavākyasadṛśa iti
na cāvihita audumbaro yūpo 'sti
tataś cāvyāmohe ca tasminn aśakyā śrutiḥ kalpayitum
tasmān nāvyapadeśyā buddhir avyapadeśyaṃ ca naḥ pratyakṣam
yat tu laukikaṃ vacanaṃ tac cet pratyayitāt puruṣād indriyaviṣayaṃ vāvitatham eva tat
śarīraguṇavidharmāṇo hi te 'yāvaccharīrabhāvitvāt
na hy atrānantaryasya vaktā kaścic chabdo 'sti
na hy etad ekaṃ vākyaṃ purastāc ca vedādhyayanād dharmajijñāsāṃ pratiṣedhiṣyati parastāc cānantaryaṃ prakariṣyati
pūrvakālatāyāṃ hi ktvā smaryate nānantarye
na cādhītavedasya snānānantaryam etad vidhīyate
kuta idaṃ samāmananti yo vidagdhaḥ sa nairṛto yo 'śṛtaḥ sa raudraḥ
śiṣṭācārasya prāmāṇyam uktaṃ nāśiṣṭasmṛteḥ
so 'yam avicārya pravartamānaḥ kaṃcid evopādadāno vihanyetānarthaṃ carcchet
yathā merum uttareṇa yāny asmajjātīyair anupalabdhapūrvāṇi svādūni vṛkṣaphalāni na tāni praty asmākam icchā bhavati
yatkālaṃ hi mardanaṃ tatkālaṃ mardanasukham

prāg bādhakajñānotpatteḥ katham avagamyate yadā na tatkāle samyagjñānasya mithyājñānasya ca kaścid viśeṣo yadā kṣudādibhir upahataṃ mano bhavatīndriyaṃ vā timirādibhiḥ saukṣmyādibhir vā bāhyo viṣayas tato mithyājñānam anupahateṣu samyagjñānam
yatkālaṃ hi mardanaṃ tatkālaṃ mardanasukham
śuktikā hi rajatavat prakāśate yatas tena pratyakṣaṃ vyabhicarati tanmūlatvāc cānumānādīny api
kathaṃ punar idam avagamyata idam tatsaṃprayoga idam anyasaṃprayoga iti
tatsaṃprayoge puruṣasyendriyāṇāṃ buddhijanma sat pratyakṣam

prāg bādhakajñānotpatteḥ katham avagamyate yadā na tatkāle samyagjñānasya mithyājñānasya ca kaścid viśeṣo yadā kṣudādibhir upahataṃ mano bhavatīndriyaṃ vā timirādibhiḥ saukṣmyādibhir vā bāhyo viṣayas tato mithyājñānam anupahateṣu samyagjñānam
ācāryacoditaḥ karomīti hi dṛśyate
ataḥśabdo vṛttasyāpadeśako hetvarthena yathā kṣemasubhikṣo 'yaṃ deśo 'to 'ham asmin deśe prativasāmīti
yad api ca samāmanantīva tatrāpi dravyasaṃskārakarmasu parārthatvāt phalaśrutir arthavādaḥ syād ity arthavādatāṃ vakṣyati
sa hi niḥśreyasena puruṣaṃ saṃyunaktīti pratijānīmahe
tatra pratyakṣatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ yathā dhūmākṛtidarśanād agnyākṛtivijñānam
pṛthagbhūtayoś ca yaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sa kṛtako dṛṣṭo yathā rajjughaṭayor iti
evaṃ jātyandhaparamparāyām api satyāṃ naiva jātucit sampratīyur vidvāṃsaḥ samyagdarśanam etad iti

prāg bādhakajñānotpatteḥ katham avagamyate yadā na tatkāle samyagjñānasya mithyājñānasya ca kaścid viśeṣo yadā kṣudādibhir upahataṃ mano bhavatīndriyaṃ vā timirādibhiḥ saukṣmyādibhir vā bāhyo viṣayas tato mithyājñānam anupahateṣu samyagjñānam

prāg bādhakajñānotpatteḥ katham avagamyate yadā na tatkāle samyagjñānasya mithyājñānasya ca kaścid viśeṣo yadā kṣudādibhir upahataṃ mano bhavatīndriyaṃ vā timirādibhiḥ saukṣmyādibhir vā bāhyo viṣayas tato mithyājñānam anupahateṣu samyagjñānam
atha yāñchabdān āryā na kasmiṃścid arthe ācaranti mlecchās tu kasmiṃścit prayuñjate yathā pikanemasatatāmarasādiśabdāḥ
catuḥsaṃkhyārtham iti cen na samuccayaśabdābhāvāt
catuḥsaṃkhyāviśiṣṭam ādānaṃ kartavyam iti vākyād avagamyate
na hi catuḥśṛṅgaṃ tripādaṃ dviśiraskaṃ saptahastaṃ kiṃcid yajñasādhanam asti
uruprathā uru prathasveti puroḍāśaṃ prathayatīty arthavādārthena punaḥśrutir yajñapatim eva tat prathayatīti
sa hi bahirdeśasambaddhaḥ pratyakṣam upalabhyate
evam adhīto vedo dharmajijñāsāyāṃ hetur jñāto 'nantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavya ity ataḥśabdasya sāmarthyam
ata etasmāt kāraṇād anantaraṃ dharmaṃ jijñāsitum icched ity ataḥśabdasyārthaḥ
na hi vismṛte vṛddhir ādaij ity asya sūtrasya kartari vṛddhir yasyācām ādis tad vṛddham iti kiṃcit pratīyeta
antareṇāpi śabdaṃ ya ākṛtim avabudhyetāvabudhyetevāsau vyaktim
etaddhi kriyata ity ucyate
taddhi nirdiśyate yasmāt sūrpeṇānnaṃ kriyate tasmāt sūrpeṇa juhotīti
tasmāddhetuvan nigadasyāpi stutir eva kāryam iti
vākyāddhi prathamāvagatād api pratiyanto 'rthaṃ dṛśyante
na ca himavadādiṣu kūpārāmādivad asmaraṇaṃ bhavitum arhati
kutaḥ prayoge hi steyādīnām ucyamāne virodhaḥ syācchabdārthas tv aprayogabhūtas tasmād upapadyeta stenaṃ mano 'nṛtavādinī vāg iti
atha kiṃ tacchāstraṃ anarthakam eva
yāvaccharīraṃ tāvad asya guṇā rūpādayaḥ
ataḥśabdo vṛttasyāpadeśako hetvarthena yathā kṣemasubhikṣo 'yaṃ deśo 'to 'ham asmin deśe prativasāmīti
tad yathā pathi jāte 'rke madhūtsṛjya tenaiva pathā madhvarthinaḥ parvataṃ na gaccheyus tādṛśaṃ hi tat
nanūktaṃ phalavacanam iha gamyate na stutir iti
